jobs.title: Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At **CryptoGex**, we specialize in designing and delivering high-impact technology experiences. We bring innovation to life through conferences, tech exhibitions, and immersive brand environments that connect companies with forward-thinking audiences.

**Position Overview**

We are currently looking for a motivated **Assistant Project Coordinator** to support project planning and event operations at our office. The Assistant Project Coordinator will support project managers and operational teams with scheduling, logistics coordination, reporting, and administrative tasks related to company events and internal projects.

------------------

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Management, or related field preferred
* Previous administrative, coordination, or project support experience preferred
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

---------------------------

* Competitive hourly pay ($24.00 - $32.00/hour)
* Health, dental, and vision insurance options
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Career advancement potential
* Collaborative and supportive work environment

jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Coordinator

**Location:** Buena Park, CA | Onsite  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Temp-to-Hire  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Compensation:** $26.00–$27.00 per hour, depending on qualifications

Job Summary

The Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily project operations, including preparing quotes, processing orders, and coordinating project details with customers, vendors, and internal teams. This role helps ensure accurate data entry, effective communication, and timely completion of project-related tasks. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities while providing excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate quotes and process orders, including entering data accurately from a variety of sources into a company's software system.
* Provide support in coordinating project details by working with customers and internal teams to ensure all aspects of the project are addressed.
* Coordinate RFQ (Request for Quotation) and project information with the sales team, vendors, factory, and managers.
* Perform customer service tasks in a polite, professional, and friendly manner.
* Assist in special projects as needed under the Project Manager's direction.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Possess a minimum of 3 years of customer service experience.
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions in a manner consistent with the essential job functions.
* Demonstrate proficiency in MS Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Possess strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively as a team player.
* Demonstrate the ability to multitask regularly and meet deadlines.
* Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrate resourcefulness, initiative, and a professional and mature attitude.
* Possess strong project management skills.

**Preferred:**

* Possess experience in the hospitality industry.

**Job Overview**

As a Project Coordinator, you’ll keep projects organized and moving forward by coordinating schedules, maintaining accurate records, and supporting clear communication with clients and colleagues. You’ll also help manage day-to-day office needs, respond to inquiries, and keep project information easy to access. Your impact: By keeping timelines, records, and communications on track, you help project teams stay focused and clients receive timely, organized support.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, project schedules, and follow-up tasks.
* Enter and update project data, maintain spreadsheets, and organize digital and paper files.
* Support office management, front desk coverage, multi-line phone systems, and customer service.
* Prepare documents using word processing and productivity software; assist with routine clerical and administrative tasks.
* Communicate with clients and team members, provide customer support, and handle calls with professional phone etiquette.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail and reliable typing and data entry.
* Computer literacy and technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and other productivity software; QuickBooks experience is useful.
* Office experience, including administrative or clerical work, filing, front desk duties, and phone communication.
* Customer service and client communication skills; experience with multi-line phone systems is preferred.
* Personal assistant experience and calendar management are helpful. Bilingual ability is a plus; it is not required.

Pay: $26.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

**POSITION SUMMARY**

To further the mission of the YMCA by providing a safe, inclusive, and engaging environment for youth. The Camp Counselor II is responsible for leading, training, and supervising a team of Camp Counselor I staff in delivering progressive, age-appropriate programs and specialized activities throughout the summer season. This role oversees residential duties to ensure staff foster a positive and supportive cabin community, maintains the highest standards of health, safety, and proactive risk management, ensures the responsible stewardship of camp facilities and equipment, and serves as a positive role model who consistently embodies the YMCA Core Values.+

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**STAFF SUPERVISION & TEAM LEADERSHIP**

* Lead, train, and supervise a team of Camp Counselor I staff serving as a positive role model and demonstrating best practices in camper engagement, behavior management, and camp operations
* Utilize prior experience to anticipate daily camp needs, take initiative during transitions, and proactively assist staff in understanding camp routines and standard operating procedures.
* Play a leading role in elevating safety standards by actively guiding peers and direct reports in the proper execution of emergency protocols, radio procedures, and YMCA Core Values.

**PROGRAM OVERSIGHT & QUALITY CONTROL**

* Ensure staff develop, facilitate, and deliver progressive, mission-driven activities tailored to the ages and abilities of the campers.
* Guide staff in debriefing activities with participants to reinforce learning and participate in continuous improvement efforts by evaluating the success of the program.
* Maintain effective, positive relationships with members, participants, and fellow staff to promote a supportive camp culture and prioritize overall youth well-being.
* Prepare & Develop activity areas, provide appropriate orientations, and teach the proper and safe use of equipment to ensure positive outcomes.
* Debrief activities with participants to reinforce learning and participate in continuous improvement efforts by evaluating the success of the program.
* Ensure staff assigned to specialized activities (High/Low Ropes, Lifeguarding, Reptiles & Animal Care, Archery, Mountain Bikes) hold required certifications and strictly follow specific manufacturer and industry safety guidelines.

**HEALTH, SAFETY & RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Oversee staff in continuously monitoring participants, equipment, facilities, and environmental conditions continuously to identify, mitigate, and report hazardous or unsafe conditions.
* Ensure all staff review and execute all emergency procedures immediately in accordance with YMCA policies, maintaining readiness for specific scenarios including missing campers, first aid responses, and facility failures.
* Use problem-solving skills to make quick decisions, direct staff during critical incidents, and ensure that both staff and campers follow all established safety procedures.
* Play an active role in elevating safety standards, maintaining clear and professional communication via standard radio procedures during daily operations and critical incidents.

**FACILITY, EQUIPMENT & OPERATIONAL STEWARDSHIP**

* Monitor staff compliance with pre-use inspections, ensuring the team demonstrates good stewardship of camp resources through the proper care, maintenance, and storage of all supplies.
* Clean, secure, and organize program areas following each use, and assist in packing materials both on a daily basis and at the close of the season.
* Verify that all staff complete required YMCA and American Camp Association (ACA) training, certifications, and annual skills assessments prior to facilitating any activities.
* Ensure required documentation is completed efficiently and promptly report any escalated incidents, hazards, policy violations, or operational concerns to management.

**COMPLIANCE, TRAINING & ADMINISTRATION**

* Complete all required YMCA and American Camp Association (ACA) training, certifications, and annual skills assessments prior to facilitating any activities.
* Follow all risk management and manufacturer guidelines, operating equipment only as authorized and seeking guidance when a task falls outside current training.
* Complete required documentation efficiently and promptly report any incidents, hazards, policy violations, or operational concerns to management.

* Report to the dining hall before meal service and support dishwashing operations.

* Maintain a clean and sanitary dish room, including cleaning work areas and removing trash.
* Follow safe work practices and report safety, sanitation, or equipment concerns.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Publicity
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

The Hulu and ABC Publicity team is seeking a Coordinator, Publicity to provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity while developing hands-on experience across the day-to-day work of the publicity function. This role is designed for someone who has a genuine interest in pursuing a career in entertainment publicity and is eager to build a strong foundation in both executive support and publicity coordination.

The Coordinator will focus on becoming highly proficient in core desk responsibilities, including calendar management, expenses, meetings, and team administration. As the individual demonstrates proficiency, they will have opportunities to take on broader publicity assignments, including media monitoring, press materials, campaign logistics, events, and special projects. Administrative support will remain an important and ongoing part of the position.

This is a developmental role intended to integrate the Coordinator into the daily needs of the business, strengthen their publicity skills, and prepare them for continued growth within the function.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity, including managing two complex calendars, coordinating meetings and conference calls, and navigating schedule changes.
* Prepare and submit expense reports; support invoices, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and other departmental administrative processes.
* Maintain team contact lists, departmental documents, status reports, and shared resources.
* Coordinate staff meetings and other group meetings; take notes, track action items, and distribute relevant information to the team.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Build strong working relationships across the Hulu and ABC Publicity teams and with internal and external partners.
* Balance the priorities of two Vice Presidents and two publicity teams, communicating proactively when needs or deadlines compete.

**As the Role Progresses, You Will Have Opportunities To:**

* Support publicity coordination activities such as media monitoring, compiling and distributing press coverage, maintaining press lists and media-site materials, and researching industry trends and media opportunities.
* Assist with drafting and proofreading publicity materials, including episodic loglines, biographies, press releases, announcements, and other campaign documents.
* Help coordinate talent and campaign logistics, including travel, schedules, glam, screenings, press junkets, panels, premieres, awards events, and other publicity activities.
* Participate in team brainstorms and contribute to campaign, event, and special-project execution.
* Support publicity events as needed, including occasional evenings and weekends.
* Take on additional publicity responsibilities based on demonstrated proficiency, capacity, business needs, and readiness, while continuing to provide essential administrative support.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated interest in building a career in entertainment publicity; candidates seeking a role focused solely on executive administration may not be the best fit.
* Prior administrative, communications, publicity, marketing, agency, studio, network, platform, or related experience.
* Ability to learn and become proficient in executive desk responsibilities while showing initiative and curiosity about the broader publicity function.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and time-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional judgment and ability to handle confidential information discreetly.
* Collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented approach with a strong team mentality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Google Suite.
* Ability to balance the priorities of two senior executives and two publicity teams, exercise sound judgment, and communicate proactively when needs or deadlines compete.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of relevant administrative, publicity, communications, marketing, or entertainment experience.
* Familiarity with publicity and media-monitoring tools such as Muck Rack, TVEyes, or similar services.
* Knowledge of television, streaming, entertainment, media, and pop-culture trends.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Disney Television Animation (DTVA) has over forty years of legacy as a top producer of kids & family entertainment. Our work is integral to The Walt Disney Company, bringing Disney-branded characters and stories to families’ homes across the globe.

  

DTVA creates both long-form and short-form content spanning traditional 2D, rig-based 2D, CG (preschool), CG (premium), and stop-motion. We create shows in a broad range of unique and innovative styles, and we aim to match the right talent with the right production in terms of skill and artistic style.

By submitting an application for this **Production Coordinator** job posting, you may be considered for any **Production Coordinator** positions that arise until the expiration date provided.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating digital advertising campaigns, maintaining brand website content, supporting product launches and promotional activities, preparing marketing performance reports, and collaborating with internal teams, external agencies, and brand partners to ensure marketing initiatives are executed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. The Digital Marketing Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution and coordination of digital marketing, e-commerce, and brand marketing initiatives across Philips, Skyworth, and Panasonic TV brands in North America. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects in a fast paced environment. This role provides essential executional and operational support to the Senior Marketing Specialist, helping maintain consistent marketing activities and effective collaboration across brands, channels, and stakeholders.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Digital Advertising & Retail Media Support

* Support digital advertising campaigns across Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor campaign spending, pacing, performance metrics, and product availability, flagging issues for follow-up.
* Coordinate campaign updates, budget adjustments, creative asset submissions, and promotional changes with agency partners.
* Maintain advertising calendars, campaign trackers, budget records, and performance dashboards.
* Compile weekly and monthly advertising reports and follow up with agencies on campaign performance, deliverables, and optimization updates.
* Assist with implementing approved media plans and campaign adjustments.

Brand Website Content Management

* Maintain and update Philips, Skyworth, and Panasonic brand websites for the North American market.
* Ensure website content is accurate, up to date, consistent with approved brand guidelines, and aligned with product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Product, and Creative teams to collect assets, confirm product information, and implement content updates.
* Support new product page development, campaign landing pages, product launch updates, and seasonal content refreshes.
* Conduct regular website audits to identify outdated content, broken links, missing assets, and other errors.
* Assist with basic website SEO initiatives, including page titles, metadata, descriptions, internal linking, and content optimization to improve organic visibility.
* Monitor website functionality and user experience, escalating technical issues, and coordinating resolutions with relevant teams or external website partners.

Performance Reporting & Analysis

* Collect and organize advertising, website traffic, and social media performance data from internal reports, agency dashboards, and digital platforms.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports and maintain accurate tracking files.
* Monitor key metrics, including advertising spend, ROAS, attributed sales, conversion rate, impressions, clicks, website traffic, and engagement.
* Flag significant performance changes, budget pacing issues, and other concerns for further review.
* Assist with competitive research, campaign analysis, and performance benchmarking to support marketing planning.

Social Media Management

* Maintain active social media pages across relevant platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Schedule and publish approved content in alignment with marketing calendars, product launches, promotional campaigns, and brand initiatives.
* Adapt existing creative assets for different social media platforms.
* Monitor comments and messages, escalating customer inquiries or issues as needed.
* Track social media performance, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, and video views, and identify opportunities to improve content performance.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in marketing, digital marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or brand marketing coordination.
* Hands-on experience supporting digital advertising or retail media campaigns on one or more platforms, such as Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, or Meta Ads.
* Experience updating website content through a content management system (CMS), such as product pages or campaign landing pages.
* Ability to compile and interpret campaign, website, and social media performance data and prepare recurring reports.
* Experience scheduling and publishing content across major social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills for collaborating with internal teams, external agencies, and brand partners.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* digital marketing coordination: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Public Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, please attach a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) is seeking a **Public Communications Coordinator** to join its team. As part of our growing communications team, this position will work alongside another Communications Coordinator to support the team’s expanding communications and outreach efforts. The **Public Communications Coordinator** will work with a multidisciplinary team to develop and disseminate resources that promote and enable longitudinal and cross-country analyses on aging, health, and retirement, including contextualizing and communicating newly available resources and data on exposures over the lifespan that increase dementia and other disease risk. This position requires a curious communicator who can learn, distill, and disseminate complex, technical information to a wide variety of audiences.

This is a grant funded, one year fixed term position with a hybrid work arrangement.

**Job responsibilities include:**

* Developing and maintaining communications materials
  + Drafting website content and announcements (e.g., newsletters, blogs)
  + Evaluating existing resources and editing content as necessary
  + Reviewing and copy-editing research products (e.g., journal articles, policy briefs, op-eds)
  + Maintaining and growing social media presence (e.g., X, LinkedIn; developing short-form videos or posts)
  + Creating conference and event materials (e.g., brochures/flyers, exhibit posters)
* Distilling complex, technical research topics into clear, concise, and effective content to share with a variety of audiences, both technical and non-technical
* Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely completion and distribution of communications materials
* Reviewing and revising project resources and other written materials to ensure quality, readability, and consistency
* Experience or interest in developing a communications strategy to publicize the research project and grow its audience; this may include pitching investigators and other subject matter experts for news articles, media appearances, and op-eds

**Qualifications:**

Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts, make them easily understandable through varied mediums, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine content.

Ability to collaborate effectively with numerous project stakeholders (e.g., investigators, administrative staff, university officials) at the university and with collaborators at other research institutions. Strong editing skills, ranging from developmental editing to copyediting. Graphic design experience is a plus but not required.

  

Minimum education: Bachelor’s Degree

Minimum Experience: 2+ years (3+ years preferred). Background in communications, public relations, marketing, or a related field is required. A background or experience working in academia or with clients in public health, economics, or policy is not required, but is preferred.

**Work Arrangement:**

Hybrid (3 days per week) on the University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA.

**Compensation**

The hourly rate range for this position is $31.97 - $35.35. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**

The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy & Government Service develops evidence-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, the USC Schaeffer Institute includes four flagship centers: the Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics, the Center for Economic and Social Research, the Center for Civic Society and the Leonard D. Schaeffer Fellows in Government Service.

The Schaeffer Institute is home to more than 150 scholars and staff, including three Nobel Laureates and seven members of the National Academy of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. Schaeffer experts have testified before numerous Congressional committees and are regularly sought out by media outlets—including the New York Times, NPR, Stat, Wall Street Journal, and Washington Post—to provide insight on policy issues.

The Institute has offices at USC in Los Angeles and at the USC Capital Campus in Washington, DC.

**About the Center for Civic Society at the Schaeffer Institute**

The Center for Civic Society aims to assess, strengthen and promote democratic values around the world through research, civic engagement and global dialogue. Chaired by Former Prime Minister Gordon Brown and led by Anna Saavedra, the Center for Civic Society was launched in 2026 and is dedicated to bridging political, social and economic divides through evidence-based research that informs and promotes better public policy.

**About the Sol Price School of Public Policy**

Ranked among the foremost schools of public policy in the nation, the USC Sol Price School of Public Policy generates uncommon knowledge for the common good. The school is composed of overlapping disciplines that generate innovative approaches to critical issues ranging from health-care policy to homelessness, and sustainability to congestion – to name a few. A wide-ranging curriculum, including extensive experiential learning, prepares our graduates to navigate problems that demand multi-layered solutions driven by critical, informed thinking.

The Price School, founded in 1929, is anchored by four departments: Public Policy and Management

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join Inframark:** Leading the Way in Water Management
  
Inframark's Operations and Maintenance team is an award-winning team that delivers cutting-edge water, wastewater, and public works services to municipalities, utility districts, and industries. We are dedicated to supporting our employees as well as protecting the environment and the communities we serve. You would be empowered to thrive in a dynamic, supportive, and innovative environment. Take the next step in your career and join us at Inframark. Apply today!
  
Why Work for Inframark?
  
  
Our dedication to sustainability and community impact drives us to ensure clean, safe water for future generations. Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for advancement, Inframark offers purpose-driven work and opportunities for growth. We offer an attractive salary package, including a generous benefits package with health, dental, and life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off, sick leave, holidays, and wellness plan.
  
  
Operations Coordinator
  
  
**Summary:**  
The Operations Coordinator is responsible for overseeing daily administrative operations and fostering strong, professional relationships with clients, vendors, and employees. This position supervises one direct report, the Administrative Assistant/Receptionist, and reports directly to the Project Manager. The Operations Coordinator interacts regularly with personnel across the plant and serves as a key point of contact for corporate Accounts Payable staff, clients, visitors, contractors, and employees. Success in this role requires maintaining professional, courteous, and collaborative working relationships with all stakeholders while ensuring efficient administrative support for plant operations.
  
  
**Nature & Scope-Principal Areas of Responsibilities:**  

* Assist all personnel with day-to-day administrative requirements.
* Prepare Authorized Signed Agreement (ASA) for submission and approval to client.
* Track project expenses for ASA costs. Incumbent will review monthly billings for pass thru and ASA items and submit them to the client.
* Enter reports for Burbank personnel.
* Track ASA balances and distribute to Managers.
* Review all requisitions and NPRs issued through prior to Project Manager approval.
* Cover the front desk during lunch and breaks and when direct report is out of the office.
* Review month-end financial reports and advise Project Manager of questionable items and follow-up with Client for collection of outstanding revenue; in absence of direct report will enter time for all non-exempt Burbank employees in accurate and timely manner.
* Oversee ordering of office and janitorial supplies.
* Verify all requisitions for project (GL codes and project data) and identify as ASA or pass through charge as well as reconcile all accounts for manager approval.
* Track all technical training of project personnel.
* Partners with Human Resources and completes new hire paperwork (including I-9 form and new hire orientation) and maintains local Personnel files.
* Be knowledgeable of Federal/California labor laws, including required workplace postings.
* Assimilate required Quality Control Report (QCR) data and input in report.

**Job Requirements:**  
**Education/Equivalent:**  

* Minimum of High School Diploma or equivalent required. Associates Degree Preferred in Accounting and/ or business administration.

**Work Experience Needed:**  

* Minimum of 5 years’ of administrative assistance experience, as well as accounts payable experience processing invoices.

**Special Skills/Abilities Needed:**  

* Knowledge of Google Suite and Microsoft Office, as well as PeopleSoft, ADP and VisaWorks.
* Must possess superior organizational skills and be able to plan, prioritize, and work simultaneously on multiple projects
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
* Strong aptitude for planning, organizing, scheduling, assigning and evaluating the work of subordinates.
* Ability to train, encourage, coach, and counsel subordinate employees.
* Ability to work independently and accurately, and with all levels of personnel.
* Ability to shift priorities frequently and effectively perform under pressure.

To support a safe and secure workplace, all offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of background screening, drug testing, and driving record review where applicable.
  
Inframark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.
  
Learn more about us at Operations and Maintenance - Inframark

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We're looking for an experienced Account Manager to own the renewal motion for a book of enterprise customers. This is a foundational hire on a newly built renewals team within Customer Experience, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Renewals. You will drive each renewal from early planning to on-time closure, own the forecast and the visibility around it, and work closely with the Account Team.

In our model, Renewals is responsible for the renewal process, the forecast, and early risk detection, while the Account Executive remains Accountable for the commercial outcome and the customer relationship. You will partner closely with Customer Success, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations, and help define the playbooks, handoffs, and reporting.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Renewal Execution & Forecasting

* Drive the end-to-end renewal process for your book, from early planning through quote, contracting, negotiation support, and on-time close, including multi-year terms, co-terming, pricing uplifts, and partner, reseller, and marketplace renewals
* Deliver against the team's core KPIs: cohort renewal rate (renewals closed as a share of those up for renewal in the period), on-time renewal performance, and forecast accuracy
* Maintain an accurate renewal forecast and clear visibility into each renewal's stage and quote status from kickoff to signature, and report it regularly to leadership

Risk & Retention

* Accurately forecast risk once identified to ensure a plan can be put in place well in advance of the renewal
* Own execution of the save plan (the actions to retain an at-risk customer) alongside the Sales and Customer Success
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on renewal strategy, pricing, and negotiation, and support executive conversations on large accounts
* Analyze renewal and churn trends and share insights with Product, Customer Success, and GTM teams

Process & Partnership

* Run clear handoffs across Renewals, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Deal Desk
* Work with Finance and Sales Operations to streamline approvals, paperwork, and CRM data quality
* Build renewal playbooks, account plans, workflows, dashboards, and reporting that shorten cycle time and reduce manual work

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years of experience in renewals, account management, customer success, or sales/revenue operations, with direct ownership of a renewal-rate or retention number
* Experience managing renewals for enterprise accounts, including multi-year contracts, executive stakeholders, and customers across regions and time zones
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, data security, cloud security, or AI, with the ability to discuss customer value, adoption, and risk credibly with security and data leaders
* Experience negotiating or supporting complex enterprise contracts, including working with Legal on redlines and Finance on pricing approvals
* Ability to partner with Sales in a model where renewals execution is separate from commercial deal ownership
* Strong forecasting skills, with fluency in Salesforce and CPQ/CLM tools and the analytical ability to turn data into clear recommendations
* Experience improving processes, dashboards, or reporting with measurable impact, and comfort creating visibility where tooling falls short
* Executive presence and excellent cross-functional communication skills
* Experience with Clari, Ironclad, Gainsight, or similar tools, and with using AI tools to improve forecasting and workflows, is a plus
* This is a US-based position; West Coast or Central time zones are preferred, and we are open to candidates anywhere in the US
* Ability to travel approximately 25%

**COMPENSATION INFORMATION:**

Compensation Range: $100,000-$150,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

**BENEFITS - Why Cyera?**

* Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
* Competitive salary
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid holidays and sick time
* Health, vision, and dental insurance
* Life, short and long-term disability insurance

jobs.description:
*Twenty years ago, Les Composantes began with a selection of vintage pieces, born from a desire for creative independence and an eye for detail. That instinct and an appreciation for design that endures have shaped everything that followed.*

*From there, Sézane was born in Paris in 2013. Since then, la famille has continued to grow, with Octobre Éditions for men, Les Composantes reimagined as a home and lifestyle destination, and Petit Sézane for children.*

*Our story has unfolded like life itself: through instinct, spontaneity, and learning. We developed a singular approach to detail, service, and connection. A way of imagining a Parisian wardrobe for real life, first online and later through our Appartements. From day one, we have been guided by a commitment to making beautiful design accessible, without ever compromising on quality.*

To continue to co-construct the next chapter and beyond, we are looking for creative, organized and agile talents, who share our passion to perpetually improve all that can be.

Care to imagine what comes next with us? We can’t wait to hear from you!

We are seeking the talents of a **Retail Operations Coordinator - West** to join our Retail Ops Team. This role is based in our West Hollywood office and requires regular domestic travel.

The Retail Operations Coordinator helps drive smooth day-to-day store operations and contributes to a cohesive, on-brand experience for Sézane customers and internal teams. This role prioritizes inventory accuracy, efficient operational execution, facilities coordination, and alignment of processes across Sézane’s West Coast retail fleet, working closely with Store Directors and cross-functional teams.

Reporting to the Retail Operations Manager US, the ideal candidate brings a blend of precision, analytical thinking, and adaptability, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves on tasks ranging from stockroom management and reporting to maintenance coordination, process implementation, and store technology.

**About the Role**

**Facilities & Maintenance**

* Serve alongside the Retail Operations Manager as a key point of contact for West Coast store maintenance requests, ensuring timely resolution and reliable communication with store teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, including obtaining and reviewing quotes, supporting vendor negotiations, scheduling work, and tracking projects through completion in partnership with the Retail Operations Manager.
* Support the day-to-day management of maintenance framework contracts and vendor relationships, monitoring costs, service levels, and adherence to agreed scopes and pricing.
* Assist in ensuring West Coast stores meet OSHA, ADA, fire, and applicable local safety and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate and schedule preventive maintenance for West Coast stores, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire safety, and other building systems, as well as maintenance needs associated with new store openings and renovations.
* Respond to urgent repair needs and support store teams with troubleshooting guidance, escalating as appropriate to the Retail Operations Manager.
* Monitor maintenance spend and quotes to help identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining appropriate service and brand standards.
* Ensure facilities maintain a clean, safe, functional, and brand-appropriate customer and employee environment.

**Back Office & Inventory Operations**

* Support daily, weekly, and monthly inventory operations across West Coast retail locations, including cycle counts and annual store inventories.
* Partner with HQ Logistics and store teams to ensure timely and accurate inventory movements, including inbound shipments, transfers, and outbound shipments/RTVs.
* Develop strong working knowledge of Sézane's retail, inventory, and planning tools and systems, serving as an operational resource for store teams and supporting troubleshooting and process adoption.
* Assist with inventory-related training materials, SOPs, and store communications.
* Support inventory processes during new store openings, store closures, system implementations, and special projects.
* Support the coordination and animation of the US stockist community, sharing best practices, operational updates, and tools to promote consistent stockroom standards across the network.

**Front of House Operations**

* Ensure customer-facing operational processes are consistent, efficient, and aligned with brand standards, including assisting with the creation and implementation of scalable SOPs and operational projects.
* Monitor key Customer Experience and operational KPIs, including guest rate, opt-in rate, mobile checkout rate, web orders, and other relevant metrics, helping identify trends and coordinate action plans with store teams and the Retail Operations Manager.
* Act as a point of contact for POS-related issues, escalations, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with onboarding and training store teams on POS enhancements, new tools, and operational workflows.
* Monitor store technology and devices, including iPads, scanners, printers, routers, and charging stations, and coordinate the replacement of outdated or damaged equipment.
* Monitor developments in retail technology and operational tools, benchmarking potential solutions and proposing opportunities to improve or digitize store operations.
* Participate in cross-functional Task Forces and special projects with Retail, IT, Logistics, Planning, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to support operational improvements and new initiatives.

**Store Visits & Reporting**

* Conduct structured 360° store visits across the West Coast fleet, assessing facilities, inventory, back-of-house operations, customer experience, technology, and overall operational standards, with clear reporting on observations, opportunities, and action items.
* Maintain a regular store visit cadence, with an expected minimum of once per month for LA locations and every two months

**Benefits**: We offer excellent Benefit Plans including incremental PTO Plan; 15 + Paid Holidays plus a Birthday Floating Holiday. 403b retirement plan with a match. Medical, Vision & Dental insurance plans with majority paid by employer. Life Insurance plan and Employee Assistance Program paid by employer.

Would you like to go to work knowing that every day you’ll be making a real difference in the lives of at-risk people in your community? At Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County that’s exactly what you’ll be doing. Every moment of your workday will directly impact our mission to provide food for those who need it, when they need it. **Come join our upbeat, collaborative team who are improving lives every day by taking hunger off the table.**

**POSITION PURPOSE:** The role of the Program Coordinator is to manage the Grocery Rescue Program and Food Rescue donations. The primary objective of this position is to coordinate all Partner Network aspects of these food donation programs to ensure food-insecure individuals, families and students are being provided fresh, nutritious food at locations throughout Orange County.

The Grocery Rescue (GR) Program involves extensive coordination and support of our 75+ partners that pick-up food donations from 250+ local grocery stores via 900+ pick-ups each week. The GR Program is carried out in collaboration with our Food Sourcing Department and the food donors they partner with. Each month, nearly 40% of all food distributed by SHFB partners is acquired through the GR Program.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Grocery Rescue Program**

* Oversee all aspects of coordinating the Grocery Rescue Program in collaboration with the GR Program Coordinator and Supervisor, and as detailed in the GR Program manual.
* Primarily work with a portfolio of 40+ GR partners.
* Coordinate grocery store pick-up schedules with each partner and in collaboration with the SHFB Sourcing Department. Ensure all needed grocery store pick-ups are covered, or work with other SHFB departments to determine a solution.
* Troubleshoot GR partner challenges or store concerns as they arise. Follow feedback procedure.
* Ensure all GR pickup poundage receipts are submitted each week by all GR partners within assigned portfolio. Carry out corrective action procedures for late or missed reporting, as needed.
* Proactively look for anomalies in the data and seek answers from partners to address concerns.
* Develop, maintain, and cultivate new and existing Grocery Rescue partnerships.
* Train and supervise partners in assigned portfolio. Set proper expectations for program operations to ensure the program is always carried out by partner staff and volunteers.
* Conduct annual GR partner training and additional training as needed.
* Ensure partner compliance with program rules and regulations, as detailed in the Grocery Rescue Program Agreement – including food safety and reporting requirements.
* Carry out new GR partner onboarding processes.
* Conduct compliance site visits at GR partner locations, as assigned.
* Provide ongoing support to GR partners via email, phone calls and in-person or Zoom meetings as needed.
* Ensure all Program information in documents, files, and spreadsheets are kept up to date.
* Proactively look for solutions to partner challenges in executing the GR program. Including providing guidance and/or working with SHFB Sourcing department to overcome obstacles.
* Proactively look for ways to continuously improve the Grocery Rescue Program, including its effectiveness and how to better meet the needs of our partners.
* Demonstrate Service Excellence and Integrity when carrying out all aspects of program management.
* Actively participate in weekly team meetings and report updates, concerns, and successes in group meetings and at 1:1s.
* Attend webinars and trainings to increase food bank, food & nutritional insecurity, and Feeding America knowledge.
* Assist in collecting client stories for Grant Reports and various Development Department needs.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:**

* Ability to lift 25-50 pounds to carry equipment and supplies as needed.
* Regular driving throughout Orange County.
* Extended periods of sitting working on computer or on phone.
* Indoor office environment, indoor warehouse environment with moderate noise at food bank location.
* Up to 25% of time spent off-site at Community Partner locations and attending various meetings.
* Office hours are 8am – 4:30pm, but schedule varies based on department needs. Possible evening and weekend hours.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bilingual English/Spanish required (written and verbal).
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience.
* Must have prior professional experience in non-profit, program coordination, or grocery retail.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* A professional who is reliable, proactive communicator and actively engaged member of the team.
* Self-starter with the ability, confidence, and good judgment to move projects forward with minimal supervision from direct Supervisor.
* Nurture strong professional relationships with coworkers, partners – current and potential, and external stakeholders.
* Excellent professional verbal and written communication skills. Communicate comprehensively with direct supervisors and the Director of Programs & Services on an on-going basis.
* Proven experience using logical reasoning to identify areas for improvement and to problem solve. Proactive about seeking solutions to meet program, partner, and team goals.
* Dedication to continuous improvement and experience with making changes that lead to improved results

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's communications team is responsible for defining, shaping, promoting, and protecting the narrative around Anduril's products and people, both internally and externally. As part of Anduril's division comms vertical, you will support a specific suite of products, related contracts, and the team building them. The right person for this role is deadline-driven, an excellent communicator and extremely organized.

  

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The role supports Anduril's Connected Warfare division which builds the software, computing hardware, and networks that connect people, sensors, and autonomous systems across land, sea, air, and space. By bringing these systems and their data together, we help military teams build a shared picture of the battlefield, make faster decisions, and coordinate operations.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Help drive strategic and tactical communications programs that proactively advance Anduril's goals.
* Support external communications campaigns, including contract announcements, product launches, military exercise recaps, social media content, and executive thought leadership.
* Support earned media strategies and pitches to reporters to secure coverage in targeted media outlets where policymakers and influencers go to stay informed.
* Track, evaluate, and action incoming speaking requests.
* Work cross-functionally with partners in marketing, design, government relations, and across each of the business lines within the division.
* Support internal communications campaigns and events designed to ensure that the division runs effectively and employees remain inspired and informed.
* Help translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for non-technical audiences.

  

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1-2 years of communications experience in defense and national security, technology, policy, public relations, or related field(s)
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills, and a passion for storytelling.
* Strong organizational, project management, and analytical skills.
* Strong interest in current events
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your app

**Location:** Must live in US, in region

**Department:** Business Development

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits including 401k matching; PTO; 100% paid parental leave; 100% paid employee health, dental and vision benefits; remote work options; and an award-winning workplace culture.

  

**Job Overview:**

Genea is in an exciting phase of growth, and there’s never been a better time to join the team! We’re scaling rapidly, expanding our team, and creating brand-new roles—like this one—to help us innovate faster, serve our customers better, and take our success to the next level.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for engaging directly with large enterprise end users selling Genea Access Control solutions. This role is responsible for developing, expanding and maintaining ecosystem and integrator partner relationship, and will work directly with their respective global accounts teams. This individual is an experienced solutions salesperson who can think wholistically about modern SaaS applications, end customer’s adoption of cloud technologies, and various go to market strategies. The Genea KAM position requires travel and a strong aptitude for account management, technical sales, and working across a wide variety of enterprise sales environments. The Key Account Manager position reports directly to the Head of Sales.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage strategic channel partner relationships.
* Drive revenue through new customer acquisition.
* Target large, distributed, and often global end customers.
* Manage accounts through a complex buying process.
* Deliver expert quality sales presentations, end user demos of Genea access control, and visitor management solutions.
* Create strategic account plans that outline goals, strategies, and action steps to ensure alignment between the partner's objectives and the Genea organization.
* Conduct regular QBRs with accounts to discuss progress, outcomes, and any adjustments needed to the account plan.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, gather feedback, and share results to continuously improve the account experience and ensure future success.
* Use data and analytics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.
* Utilize and leverage data to construct, forecast, and manage sales activities to meet revenue targets and company goals.
* Manage a travel schedule comprised of weekly/monthly trips – meeting customers, prospects, and technology partners. Expected travel is 40%.
* Work within a team to develop sale proposals, quotations, and pricing strategies to win business.
* Stay current with the latest developments in the marketplace and competitor activities.
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute in-market customer events.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5-7 years of sales experience with a B2B SaaS company managing Key Accounts in Physical Security or related product types, in a channel environment
* Must reside in the US within the territory (CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, WY, NV, UT, or AZ).
* Bachelor's Degree with a concentration in Business, Communications, or related focus area is preferred.
* Proven track record in technical sales and key account management.
* Demonstrated ability to consistently generate revenue and exceed sales goals by managing processes for identifying, qualifying, and closing new business.
* Experience utilizing complex sales techniques within the enterprise sales process.
* Proven track record of revenue growth in a technology centric organization.
* Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
* Aptitude for presentation writing and delivery.
* Ability to travel as needed within region (approximately 25-30% travel).

  

**Estimated Salary Range:** $150K base salary, up to $240K total compensation including sales commission and bonuses

The salary range listed is our best estimate based on the role's requirements and market conditions, but the final offer may be higher or lower depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D) is seeking a** **Project Coordinator** **—an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive professional who enjoys keeping complex project work moving, managing details, and serving as a trusted resource to project teams and clients. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who communicates clearly, balances multiple priorities with confidence, and brings strong financial and project coordination capabilities to a fast-paced environment.**


This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

**The Opportunity**

At B&D, we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services and expanding our capabilities across the full project lifecycle.

As a Project Coordinator, you will provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support. You will work closely with project managers, clients, consultants, contractors, and administrative staff to keep project information, financial tracking, documentation, meetings, and key deliverables organized and moving forward.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Coordinate project schedules, deliverables, documentation, correspondence, and follow-up activities across project teams.
* Create and maintain organized electronic project files and project documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Support project financial management by assisting with budgets, cash-flow estimates, commitment schedules, monthly draw packages, payables, and financial reporting.
* Gather and review information from project stakeholders to support accurate reporting and timely processing of key deliverables.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, appointments, and site visits; prepare agendas, presentation materials, and supporting documents.
* Attend project meetings, prepare and distribute meeting minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Support coordination among clients, designers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal project team members.
* Assist with consultant, contractor, and vendor solicitation, procurement, contract administration, and approval tracking.
* Monitor project details, scope changes, requests for information, submittals, and other information flows to help keep work on schedule.
* Support project controls and reporting related to status, cost, schedule, and open items.
* Assist with proposals, contracts, and project closeout activities as needed.
* Build responsive, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders while handling confidential information with discretion.

What we are looking for:

* 4+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally within construction, owner’s representation, program management, architecture/engineering, real estate development, or a related professional services environment.
* 2+ years of financial experience, including budget tracking, project financial analysis, reporting, invoicing, draw preparation, or similar responsibilities.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required; coursework or a degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, architecture, construction, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* General understanding of project management processes, project controls, construction documentation, and sequencing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and produce high-quality work in a fast-paced project environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a broader project team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Client-service mindset and ability to build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What Sets You Apart**

You anticipate what the team needs before being asked and reliably follow work through to completion. You are comfortable working with financial and project information, enjoy bringing order to complex moving parts, and communicate confidently with clients and project partners. You stay composed when priorities shift, take ownership of details, and are motivated by becoming a trusted resource for the people you support.

Within your first six to twelve months, success will mean independently managing key administrative and coordination functions, supporting project financial tracking and reporting, and serving as a dependable resource for both clients and internal project teams.

**Why People Choose B&D**

**Impactful Mission-** Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, work, and connect.

**Learning & Growth-** We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

**Strong Culture-** Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drives how we work together.

**Robust Benefits-** Comprehensive benefits include 100% company-paid medical, dental, and prescription coverage, a targeted 7% employer-contribution 401(k), generous PTO, cell phone reimbursement and more.

**Apply Today!**

* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow floor plans, labeling systems and checklists.
* Clear communication with movers, building staff, client employees and project teams.
* Basic proficiency in Google Workspace and comfort learning project tracking tools.
* Availability to attend scheduled moves and events, including evening, overnight and weekend assignments.
* Reliable transportation to client sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Ability to move throughout project sites during extended shifts and perform setup tasks such as posting signage and placing labels, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

**Growth Opportunities**

This role can be a long-term fit for someone who enjoys project coordination, with flexibility for greater responsibility for those interested in advancing.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

This position works effectively and collegially with a broad range of staff members and has direct interaction with members of the media and demands responsibility, initiative, accuracy, diplomacy, and tact. Additionally, the Communications Coordinator will provide direct support and assistance to the Communications team, taking guidance from the Communications Manager.

The application deadline is Sunday, November 22, 2026, 9 PM PST.

* Some familiarity with local media landscape and Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco audiences.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources @ famsf.org.

\_\_\_

COFAM is the Corporation of Fine Arts Museums and is the privately funded non-profit corporation which supports the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco, a department of the City and County of San Francisco.

COFAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all phases of employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Comprising the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park, we are the largest public arts institution in the City of San Francisco and one of the largest art museums in the United States. The de Young, designed by Herzog & de Meuron and located in Golden Gate Park, showcases American art from the 17th through the 21st centuries, international contemporary art, textiles and costumes, and art from the Americas, the Pacific, and Africa. Administrative Coordinator – Evaluations & Operations

**Speech Goals Speech Therapy, Inc.**

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** South San Francisco, CA  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9am-5:30pm  
**Work Location:** In person

About Speech Goals

Speech Goals is a privately owned pediatric therapy practice serving children and families throughout San Francisco and the Peninsula. We specialize in early intervention, family-centered care, and collaborative, interdisciplinary support for young children and their caregivers.

We believe meaningful growth happens through connection, play, and developmentally appropriate experiences. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating positive, meaningful opportunities for the children and families we serve.

We are excited to expand our programs to include inclusive, community-centered playgroups where children of all abilities can explore, connect, build friendships, and learn through play!

Our goal is to create welcoming environments that celebrate individuality, encourage natural social interactions, and give children opportunities to experience the joy of playing alongside their peers.

Our administrative teams play a critical role in supporting Speech Goals' programs and operations across locations, ensuring families, therapists, and clinical teams receive the coordination and support they need.

**We are looking for someone who can take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and proactively follow through to completion — without requiring constant reminders or oversight.**

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, strong communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and accountability.

* Track outstanding referral requirements and follow up with families or referral sources as needed.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by **LOIS**, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

**Role Summary:**
-----------------

Here's the honest pitch: field sales is a brand-new motion at Filevine, and we're looking for the person who builds it. Not runs a proven playbook — writes it. You'll be the first Filevine salesperson to plant a flag in your territory, and everything you learn on the ground becomes the blueprint for the reps who come after you. If "figure it out and build it from scratch" makes you lean in rather than flinch, keep reading.  
  
This is a true outside sales role. You'll be in the field at least four days a week — walking into law firms, meeting paralegals and attorneys face-to-face, working bar association events, and becoming the most familiar name in your territory for deposition services.  
  
This isn't an email job. It's not a Zoom job. You win by showing up — consistently, professionally, and with something useful to say every time. You'll also need range: the ability to build rapport in the reception area and get your foot in the door with a paralegal, and the sophistication to sit across from a managing partner and hold your own on price, value, and strategy. This is a premium-priced product in a market full of commodity providers — so you have to be able to sell the difference, not just the service. If you love the rhythm of door-to-door selling, can navigate a downtown legal corridor, and have the discipline to run a territory like your own small business, you'll thrive here. There is no ceiling on your earnings

### **What You'll Do**

* Build the playbook. As the first rep in your territory, you'll test what works, document it, and help shape the model Filevine scales from. Your wins and your lessons both matter.
* Own a defined geographic territory and build a daily route plan that maximizes face-to-face time with litigation attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants, and firm administrators.
* Spend at least four days per week in the field — walking into firms, dropping by reception, scheduling lunches, and turning every visit into a relationship.
* Get your foot in the door at every level: earn trust with paralegals and legal staff, then work your way up to the conversations with managing partners and firm administrators who sign off on the deal.
* Sell Filevine's full deposition stack — court reporting, remote depositions, and AI-powered products including Depo CoPilot — as a premium offering in a commodity market. You'll own the "why we're worth it" story.
* Drive initial customer enablement, training, and product adoption — get new firms up and running, walk them through their first depositions, and make sure they're confident with the product. (A dedicated in-house team handles full, ongoing trainings; your job is to spark and seed adoption.)
* Attend local and regional industry events: bar association meetings, CLEs, paralegal association mixers, and trial lawyer chapters. Be the visible Filevine presence in your market.
* Run disciplined prospecting: outbound calls, drop-bys, follow-ups, and a tight cadence on every account.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every visit, conversation, and opportunity in CRM (Salesforce). Forecast projected targets and deals.
* Partner closely with Operations, Scheduling, and Client Success to deliver a seamless deposition experience.

### **You'll Crush This Role If You Have**

* 3–5+ years of outside sales experience, ideally selling into law firms or to attorneys — court reporting, legal videography, e-discovery, medical records retrieval, or legal tech.
* An existing network in the local legal community.
* A builder's mindset — you're energized by white space, ambiguity, and being the one who figures out what works before there's a manual for it.
* A proven track record of building a book of business from in-person relationships — not inbound leads.
* The range to connect with anyone in the building: warm and credible with a paralegal, sharp and strategic with a managing partner.
* Demonstrated ability to learn a new industry quickly and translate insights to subject-matter experts (in this case, litigators).
* Comfort selling a premium product against cheaper alternatives — you know how to make value the conversation instead of price.
* High activity, high agency: you build your own pipeline, run your own day, and don't wait for marketing to hand you names.
* Comfort walking into a law firm cold, navigating gatekeepers, and earning a first conversation.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation; you live in or near your assigned territory.

### **Nice to Have**

* A referral network of attorneys, court reporters, videographers, and adjacent service providers.
* Familiarity with deposition workflows, litigation timelines, and how legal services are purchased.

Compensation Information: $110,000 - $140,000 + commission

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity -
