jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end-to-end — from onboarding through renewal. You're accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion within your book of business.
* Run strategic QBRs. Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards. You'll analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
* Get technical. Understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices. You won't build data models day-to-day, but you need to read them, reason about them, and guide customers toward better architecture.
* Be the voice of the customer internally. Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights. Work closely with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues and influence the roadmap.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities. Cube's platform is evolving fast — Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks and dashboards. You'll help customers understand what's new, why it matters for their use case, and how to adopt it.
* Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities. You'll own the commercial relationship alongside our sales team. This means understanding contract timelines, building the business case for renewal, and spotting natural expansion paths — more users, embedded analytics, additional environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Must-haves:

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and you can read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong
* Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account
* Track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment
* Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable — business narrative, not just metrics
* Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting
* Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI)
* Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI — you've been on the practitioner side
* Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures
* Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical
* Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows)
* Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and generous stock options in a growing company
* Unlimited PTO — we actually use it
* Remote-first culture with coworking space stipend if you prefer not working from home
* Team offsites several times a year (locations rotate between the US and Europe)
* Professional development budget — training courses, books, conferences
* The chance to work on a product that sits at the center of the modern data stack and the AI-native future

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call — 30 min with the recruiting team
* Hiring manager conversation — 45 min to discuss your experience, approach, and what you're looking for
* Take-home exercise — prepare and present a mock QBR using a provided data pack (~3–4 hours of prep + 30 min live presentation)
* Cross-functional interviews — conversations with team mem

jobs.description:

========================

**Location:** Onsite – Pleasanton, California

Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. The Logistics Coordinator II is responsible for supporting warehouse operations, shipping and receiving, RMA parts handling and vendor returns, asset and inventory management, and day-to-day facilities coordination. This role serves as a key operational resource for inventory tracking, equipment receiving and outbound shipments, vendor and ticket coordination, and warehouse organization. **Shipping & Logistics**

* Coordinate shipping and receiving activities for internal and customer equipment.
* Palletize equipment for outbound shipments and deployment preparation.
* Perform FedEx drop-offs and support smaller shipment logistics.
* Validate incoming shipping orders and ensure order accuracy.

**Ticketing & Vendor Coordination**

* Open and manage CoreSite tickets for Jenny orders and related facility requests.
* Coordinate with vendors, carriers, and data center personnel to support operational activities.
* Track ticket status and ensure timely completion of service requests.

**Asset & Inventory Management**

* Manage asset tracking for customer consignments and internal company equipment.
* Apply asset tags and maintain accurate asset documentation and inventory records.
* Track hardware lifecycle information including deployment, storage, return, and disposal status.
* Conduct inventory audits and assist with reconciliation activities.
* Maintain accurate records within asset management systems and spreadsheets.

* High school diploma or equivalent required; technical certifications or related education preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in technical operations, warehouse coordination, IT support, or facilities operations preferred.
* Basic understanding of networking hardware, server equipment, and infrastructure environments.
* Experience with shipping/logistics processes and inventory management.
* Ability to lift and move equipment safely in warehouse and deployment environments.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, inventory systems, and asset tracking tools.
* Valid driver’s license preferred for shipping drop-offs and local operational support.

**Preferred**

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Hands-on technical troubleshooting ability
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation practices
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Customer service mindset with responsiveness and professionalism
* Comfortable working in warehouse, office, and data center environments
* Basic networking and hardware knowledge
* Ability to follow operational procedures and maintain accuracy
* Proactive problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Ellipsis Health builds AI products that take on healthcare's staffing shortages and administrative burden, pairing conversational AI with our patented voice biomarker technology to help deliver better healthcare for everyone. Our voice agents talk with patients every day: booking and rescheduling appointments, answering billing questions, handling medication refills, and checking in after a hospital visit.

This role drives growth and operations for our provider business, which serves health systems, provider groups, and FQHCs. You'll work across the provider teams within Ellipsis, from sales and deployment to customer success, product, and engineering, and report into provider segment leadership.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're seeking a Business Operations Associate to play a critical role in driving growth, operational excellence, and customer success. You'll work across three areas: business operations, customer experience, and data and analytics, using a combination of analytical, operational, and technical skills to evaluate key business problems while weighing the needs of a variety of stakeholders, from internal teams to senior health system leaders.

The ideal candidate blends strategic thinking, analytical horsepower, and hands-on execution, has exceptional attention to detail, high drive and low ego, and is energized by tackling the complex, interesting challenges of a rapidly scaling startup.

Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

CUNY SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

No

The Research Coordinator will support the implementation and daily operations of *Our Stories, Our Bodies, Our Safety* , a community-engaged research project examining experiences of safety, community violence, mental health, and well-being among Black pregnant and postpartum women in New York City.

  

Under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI), the Research Coordinator will oversee participant recruitment and engagement, coordinate data collection activities, maintain study documentation, and support community partnerships. The Coordinator will help ensure research activities are implemented efficiently, ethically, and in accordance with institutional and IRB-approved protocols.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

**1. Participant Recruitment and Enrollment (25%)**

* Develop and implement participant recruitment strategies in collaboration with the PI.
* Coordinate outreach to community organizations, maternal health programs, and other recruitment partners.
* Distribute recruitment materials through approved community and digital channels.
* Conduct participant eligibility screening and coordinate informed consent procedures in accordance with approved study protocols.
* Maintain recruitment logs and track enrollment progress toward study targets.
Schedule participant research appointments and communicate study expectations.  

  

**2. Study Coordination and Data Collection (25%)**

* Coordinate administration of study surveys and scheduling of qualitative interviews.
* Monitor completion of study activities and follow up with participants as appropriate.
* Assist with distributing, tracking, and collecting Fitbit devices used during the 14-day monitoring period.
* Maintain accurate records of participant study participation and completion.
* Coordinate participant compensation and maintain incentive distribution records.
Identify and communicate operational challenges to the PI.  

  

**3. Data Management and Research Documentation (20%)**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential research records.
* Assist with data entry, quality assurance, and verification of survey and participant tracking data.
* Manage secure participant databases and study tracking spreadsheets.
* Ensure research data are stored and handled in accordance with institutional confidentiality and data security requirements.
* Support preparation of research progress summaries and recruitment reports.
Assist with maintaining IRB documentation and protocol compliance.  

  

**4. Community Engagement and Participant Retention (20%)**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants regarding study logistics.
* Maintain culturally responsive, respectful, and trauma-informed communication with participants.
* Coordinate participant reminders, follow-up appointments, and retention activities.
* Support relationships with community-based organizations and maternal health stakeholders.
* Identify barriers to participation and work with the PI to develop appropriate solutions.
Assist with coordinating community engagement activities and dissemination efforts.  

  

**5. Administrative and Project Support (10%)**

* Attend regular study team meetings and provide updates on recruitment and project progress.
* Coordinate study schedules, supplies, and research materials.
* Assist with preparing reports and other grant-related documentation.
* Maintain study timelines and track completion of assigned project milestones.
Perform other research-related duties as assigned by the PI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, public health, social work, sociology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple research activities and maintain accurate records.
* Experience working with diverse populations and demonstrated cultural sensitivity.
* Ability to maintain participant confidentiality and follow established research protocols.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar data management tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience coordinating research studies or supporting community-based research.
* Experience with recruitment, informed consent, survey administration, or participant tracking.
* Familiarity with maternal health, mental health, reproductive health, or health equity research.
* Experience working with Black women, families, and historically underserved communities.
* Familiarity with REDCap or other research data collection platforms.
* Knowledge of human subjects research protections and IRB procedures.
Experience with wearable health technologies or digital health research.  

  

**Supervision and Reporting**

The Research Coordinator will report directly to Dr. Brianna A. Baker, Principal Investigator, and will work collaboratively with other research team members and community partners.

  

**Expected Outcomes**

The Research Coordinator will contribute to the successful recruitment and enrollment of approximately 30 participants, timely completion of study activities, accurate maintenance of research documentation, strong participant engagement and retention, and successful implementation of the project's research objective

**About Perelman Performing Arts Center (PAC NYC)**

Following 9/11, the community and civic planning process that resulted in the World Trade Center master plan in 2003 envisioned a new performing arts center as one of the anchors of the site. The Perelman Performing Arts Center (PAC NYC) opened in the Fall of 2023. Within its three flexible and intimate performance spaces, PAC NYC produces and presents multiple projects in theatre, dance, music and chamber opera. PAC NYC's mission is to create connections by cultivating bonds between extraordinary artists and communities, with exemplary performances in active dialogue across the arts, and in our flexible, intimate spaces, inviting conversation and new relationships. jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

**Our Ethos**

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

**About the Team**

The Platform team owns everything that happens after a partner signs with Rain: implementations, account management, support, and card network operations. Account Management is responsible for growing Rain's live partners, from developers and startups to enterprise card programs, through renewals, expansions into new products and regions, and commercial conversations.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will own renewals and expansions for a set of live partners in your coverage area, and be the person they go to when something about their partnership, program setup, contract, or products needs to change. Our Implementations team launches new partners; you take over once they are live. You will start by shadowing experienced AMs on renewals and expansions, then run them with an AM alongside you, then on your own.

**What you’ll do**

* Own renewals for the live partners, from the first conversation through signed paperwork
* Find and close expansion opportunities in your accounts, such as new products (cards, virtual accounts, on/offramps, wallets, cross-border payments), additional card programs, and new regions
* Grow net revenue retention (NRR) for your coverage area, and flag churn or contraction risk early
* Handle partner escalations that sit outside Support: questions about the partnership, program configuration, commercial terms, and products. Bring in Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance when needed and follow each one through to resolution
* Keep detailed account health and notes up to date
* Build a health snapshot of your accounts and use it to decide where to spend your time
* Pass partner feedback to Product to help shape the roadmap
* Help write and improve Account Management playbooks, including expansion playbooks for new products and features
* Learn Rain's products in depth, including stablecoin card issuing, card network basics, and our APIs

**You are likely to succeed if you have:**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in account management, as an account executive, or in customer success, in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS
* Comfort talking with partners about renewals, pricing, and commercial terms, and asking for the expansion when the opportunity is there
* Clear written and verbal communication on calls, over email, and in shared Slack channels with partners
* Strong organization: you can keep many accounts, deadlines, and follow-ups moving at the same time
* Curiosity about how payments work (card issuing, authorization, settlement) and about stablecoins, and a willingness to learn technical topics, including reading API documentation
* Ownership: when a partner raises an issue, you see it through to resolution, even when it needs help from several teams
* Comfort working at a fast-growing company

**Bonus attributes:**

* Exposure to card issuing, embedded finance, crypto, or stablecoins
* Experience working toward a renewal, upsell, or expansion target

**Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:**

**Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

**Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

**Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

**Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

**Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

**Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

**In-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

**Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $90K - $115K

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
* Experience working directly at or with major social platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and managing ongoing technical operations.
* Strong understanding of AI/automation in digital media; hands-on experience using or implementing AI tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and client communication skills, with a proven track record of managing and meeting strict contractual client SLAs.
* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions, effectively collaborating across departments (Product, Engineering, Sales, BD) to achieve client objectives.
* Comfort operating in a fluid, evolving role with undefined or shifting responsibilities; adaptability is essential.
* BA/BS required.

### **Success Measures**

* **Client Satisfaction and Retention:** High client satisfaction scores and strong retention and growth of client business.
* **Operational Efficiency and AI-Implementation:** Measurable time savings and workflow improvements achieved for client support operations through implementation of AI tools.
* **Business Acumen in Practice:** Demonstrated ability to apply contract and SLA knowledge to day-to-day prioritization, escalation, and client management decisions.
* **Critical Thinking & Navigating Ambiguity:** Proven ability to operate in complex, undefined situations — applying critical thinking, building structure without formal guidance, and making sound decisions with incomplete information.

**IAS Pay Transparency:**

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location, and any additional locations are listed below. Our pay ranges are based on the work location. As part of IAS compensation package, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance (medical, dental, vision) as well as PPO, HSA and FSA options and 401k with employer matching contributions. All full-time employee roles include competitive compensation and are eligible for an annual bonus and/or other incentive plans. jobs.description:
**Who we are**

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they're in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we're proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they're entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

  

**What you will do**

As an Operations Specialist, you will help keep daily facility operations running smoothly by processing orders, coordinating delivery pickups, and resolving operational issues. You will support restaurant partners, handle administrative tasks, train and coach team members, and maintain a clean, organized facility that meets health and safety standards.

  

**What we're looking for**

* Transport orders from kitchens to the facility's central processing area.
* Process orders and prepare them for pickup by delivery partners.
* Identify and troubleshoot operational issues promptly.
* Take ownership of issues and coordinate with partners, employees, and third parties to resolve them.
* Support daily administrative tasks, including sorting incoming packages and deliveries, maintaining inventory counts, and monitoring emails and instant messages.
* Respond promptly to restaurant partners' questions, requests, and concerns.
* Train and coach team members to ensure consistent execution of operational procedures.
* Maintain a clean facility, assign cleaning tasks, and conduct compliance checks to ensure health code standards are met.

  

**Why join us**

* Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
* Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
* Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our Tribeca office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base starting rate for this role is **$18.00 - $20.00 per hour.**

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Systems Manager
jobs.description:
**Revenue Systems Manager at Ardoq**
====================================

**Keep our GTM systems running smoothly, so the people closest to our customers can always rely on the tools.**

**The Ardoq Story**
-------------------

Ardoq is one of Norway's most exciting scale-ups, a truly global company built out of Oslo. We are a SaaS platform that helps organizations understand, manage, and evolve their complex digital landscape. By providing a dynamic, collaborative "digital twin" of their business, we connect systems, people, and processes to drive better decision-making and accelerate digital transformation.

Today, we help some of the world's most complex organizations, like ExxonMobil and BT, gain clarity in a changing world. We are backed by leading global tech investors, including EQT and One Peak, giving us the stability of a mature company with the speed and soul of a startup.

**About the Role**
------------------

Every GTM team at Ardoq depends on Salesforce and its integrated applications working the way they should: a lead reaching the right rep in seconds, a quote going out the door in minutes. As our Revenue Systems Manager, you'll be responsible for the health of Salesforce and its integrations, moving seamlessly between quick tickets and carefully scoped system improvements.

In this role, you’ll be working closely with our Customer leadership to support our processes and insights that drive renewals, expansion and retention.

At Ardoq, we value autonomy and psychological safety. In this role, you won't just follow a script; you will have the influence to shape your domain and the ownership to see your ideas through to execution.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own Salesforce, end to end: You'll be one of two dedicated Salesforce admins owning user set-up and permissions, as well as the configuration and ongoing optimization of Salesforce as part of our wider tech ecosystem.
* Partner across GTM: work closely with Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services and Sales to turn real business problems into system solutions people actually trust and use.
* Lead system projects: you’ll drive system projects that might range from deploying a CPQ tool to establishing a robust Customer SQL framework.
* Cultural contribution: help shape the habits of a small, high-trust team where picking up a ticket and shipping a project matter equally.

**On a typical day, you will**
------------------------------

Start by clearing a handful of tickets, the small stuff that keeps Sales and CS moving. Then shift into project mode: reviewing a Flow that's throwing errors, scoping the next phase of an important integration, or sitting down with our VP of Customer Success or Professional Services to optimize a post-sales process. You'll lean on AI tools daily, to check a formula, sanity-check an automation, or move faster through a repetitive task, because that's simply how good admin work gets done now. Some days are almost entirely tickets. Some are almost entirely project work. Most days are a mix of both.

**Who you are**
---------------

The Experience: you hold a current Salesforce Administrator certification and have supported Salesforce inside a high-growth tech company. You’ve had roles with a dedicated focus on customer operations and understand how to support a Customer team and their focus on renewals and retention.

The Mindset: you're happy being one of a small team, not one of many. You move comfortably between answering a ticket and running a project, often on the same day, and the unglamorous work isn't beneath you.

The Tools: You're a certified Salesforce Admin. You use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow, not as an occasional experiment, to move faster and catch things you'd otherwise miss.

The Communicator: you can explain a system change to a non-technical stakeholder in terms of what it means for their day, not just what changed under the hood.

**The "Ardoq Way"**
-------------------

We live by three values, Bold, Caring, and Driven, that define how we work, how we treat each other, and how we win.

* BOLD: you continuously raise the bar for yourself and others, starting from a place of "what if I could?" You act decisively, even when the information isn't complete, choosing forward motion and learning over waiting for the perfect answer.
* CARING: you care enough to be candid, delivering direct, kind, and timely feedback that helps your teammates grow. You operate as one team, sharing knowledge openly, celebrating others' wins, and putting collective success ahead of your own.
* DRIVEN: at Ardoq, everyone has a stake in the outcome, including stock options. You act like an owner: measuring success by impact rather than effort, saying "no" to distractions, and staying focused on the highest-value work at pace.

**Why Ardoq?**
--------------

We believe that high performance is powered by wellbeing. You'll have access to a competitive package that supports performance, wellbeing, and long-term success.

* Employee Stock Options, share in Ardoq's success as we grow together
* 25 days annual leave, offered globally
* Enhanced parental leave, available globally, to support you and your family
* 401(k) retirement plan, and health, disability, and life insurance
* Annual learning budget to support your growth and development
* New York-based team members should be excited to be in the office once or twice a week.

Compensation: $120,000 - $140,000

**How to Apply**
----------------

Send us your resume, we'd love to hear from you. Our hiring process typically includes: TA screen hiring manager interview case interview values interview. We provide thoughtful feedback at every step.

**Final Note**
--------------

At Ardoq, every teammate has a voice. Whether you love tackling enterprise-scale challenges or improving how companies run, you'll not only belong, you'll impact, grow, and make work meaningful.

### **About Conduit Health**

Conduit Health is transforming one of the most outdated corners of post-acute care—getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients' homes. We're the first vertically integrated, AI-powered platform to unite ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. In seconds, case managers and providers can say "yes" to patients who would otherwise wait weeks — while we handle every step behind the scenes.  
  
**The Role**

We are looking for a Content & Social Media Manager to own our social media channels and build the content engine that will help propel Conduit into the next stage of growth.

The best fit for this role is someone who is hungry to be a true operator and build a function from the ground up. You'll work directly with senior leadership to help craft the Conduit story and be hands on keyboard executing on that vision. You're comfortable operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with shifting priorities.

This role reports to the Head of Marketing. It's a hands-on individual contributor role today, with the resources you need to move fast – and a clear path to growing a team around you.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Organic channel ownership:** Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit & more. You'll build the roadmap, expand our presence, own the calendar, write the copy, and post the content.
* **Build the content engine:** Blog posts, newsletters, case studies, social posts (video, static & written), Influencer content, white papers, patient stories & more. You'll manage how to produce content that is SEO-minded & valuable to patients at scale, and decide what’s built in-house or resourced.
* **Community management:** Directly engage and manage our brand sentiment across Facebook groups, Reddit threads, LinkedIn posts, ads etc. You’ll partner closely with patient experience to connect patients with the right members of our team.
* **Tell the story:** Work with leadership and the founders to sharpen how we communicate what we're building to our audiences: patients & caregivers, partner organizations, health plans and more.
* **Go where you’re needed:** Because this role is at the center of crafting our story, you’ll be a valuable collaborator for things like influencer & affiliate marketing, one-pagers, collateral, FAQs and comms.
* **Measure and adjust:** You’ll define what success looks like, and use data to measure it.

### **Who You Are**

* **Builder:** You want to create a function and make decisions that matter. The blank page excites you.
* **Native to the feed:** You understand how these platforms actually work, and know how to leverage all the tools available to earn the right engagement.
* **Clear & efficient writer:** You’re a strong writer across a number of mediums, and you’re comfortable with fast turnarounds.
* **Creator:** You are excited about concepting, producing and publishing a high volume of content.
* **AI-assisted:** You understand the value of craft and human touch, and know how to leverage AI to improve your workflow and output.
* **Thoughtful:** You understand who our audience is and know how to meet them on their level. We are helping vulnerable people and their loved ones tackle serious challenges, not selling energy drinks.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years in social, content, or brand marketing — agency or in-house, startup experience a plus.
* Writing samples or a portfolio of your work.
* Hands-on experience managing organic social media accounts.
* Excitement around joining an early-stage, high-growth and high-impact organization that's building something transformative.

**In your first 90 days you’ll:**

* Launch a consistent presence on LinkedIn and Meta.
* Build the content playbook: calendar, voice guidelines, templates, review process.
* Publish our first SEO-driven guides and case studies.
* Show early movement against baseline in SEO, engagement, and audience growth.

### **Our Values**

* **Excellence, Not Perfection:** We set a high bar for our work and impact, but we don't get lost in endless polish for polish's sake. We focus on results that matter.
* **Urgency, Not Chaos:** We move fast because speed drives our advantage. We pair urgency with clarity to avoid noise and burnout.
* **Systems, Not One-Offs:** Every solution should eliminate the root cause so the problem never returns. Wins are good; scalable systems are better.
* **Committed, Not Just Here:** We show up engaged, proactive, and ready to go above and beyond. The outcomes you drive are what matter most.
* **Crush Goals, Not Souls:** We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Be yourself, bring positivity, have fun, and laugh often.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* Flexible hybrid work environment
* Unlimited PTO + company holidays
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Direct mentorship and growth opportunities
* Opportunity to help shape and scale operations at a fast-growing healthcare startup

### **Equal Opportunity**

Conduit Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**

Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network focused on late-phase, industry-sponsored trials for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator I at our clinical research site located in the Bronx. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience. Experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

  

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

**Benefits**:

* 401(k) matching
* Medical, Dental &Vision insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance

  

Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. All employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline, and termination, are made based on the candidate's or employee's qualifications relevant to the position. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

In compliance with federal law, all individuals hired must, as a condition of employment, provide documentation verifying their identity and authorization to work in the United States and complete Form I-9 within the required timeframe. Adams Clinical participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Finance & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
AAA Parking is committed to delivering Excellence at Every Turn — providing best-in-class parking operations and customer experiences across our growing portfolio of managed facilities. With nearly 1,100 employees nationwide, we partner with municipalities, commercial property owners, and hospitality clients to deliver safe, efficient, and service-oriented parking solutions.

We believe that every interaction — from the attendant at the gate to the finance professional ensuring our vendors are paid accurately and on time — is an opportunity to demonstrate our standard of excellence. Joining AAA Parking means joining a team that takes pride in its work and its people.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Gen Admin & Accounts Payable support is responsible for assisting with managing the full-cycle accounts payable process for AAA Parking, ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, employee expense reimbursements, and corporate credit card transactions across all managed facilities and corporate operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for vendor relationships and internal stakeholders, requiring a high degree of accuracy, organizational discipline, and customer service orientation. The Finance & Administrative Coordinator works closely with the Controller, Operations, and HR to support compliance with the company's Travel & Business Expense Policy, Corporate Credit Card Program, and Petty Cash procedures. This position is well-suited for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a high-volume, fast-paced environment and is looking to grow within a dynamic, multi-site services organization.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*The following responsibilities represent the core functions of this role. Other duties may be assigned as business needs evolve.*

* Assist with full-cycle accounts payable including receipt, coding, approval routing, and payment of vendor invoices across all AAA Parking locations and the corporate office.
* Assist with processing employee expense reports in accordance with AAA Parking's Travel & Business Expense Policy, verifying receipts, appropriate GL coding, and proper manager approvals prior to reimbursement.
* Assist with reconciling and auditing corporate credit card statements monthly, ensuring all charges are accompanied by receipts, proper business justification, and authorized approvals; escalate policy exceptions to the Controller.
* Assist with performing three-way matching (purchase order, receipt, and invoice) for applicable transactions and flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Understudying of the full AP cycle
* Respond to vendor inquiries regarding invoice status, payment timing, and account disputes in a professional and timely manner.
* Assist with AR deposit daily
* Salesforce admin support
* Assist in the administration of the petty cash process, reviewing field site reimbursement requests for completeness and compliance.
* Assist in identifying process improvement opportunities within the AP function, including automation through Microsoft 365 tools (ACH roll out).
* Administrative assistance to the receptionist position
* Administrative assistance to HR or other departments as required from time to time.
* Other duties as required.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: Associate's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Experience: 2+ years of accounts payable or general accounting experience, preferably in a multi-site or service-industry environment.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint); experience with accounting or ERP software (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, or similar).
* Attention to Detail: Demonstrated ability to process high volumes of transactions accurately with minimal errors.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact professionally with vendors, field managers, and senior leadership.
* Other: Ability to work a standard Monday–Friday schedule with occasional flexibility during month-end and audit periods.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with expense management platforms (e.g., Emburse, Concur, or similar).
* Familiarity with 1099 preparation and annual IRS reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting AP in a company with corporate credit card programs and multi-state payroll or vendor activity.
* Knowledge of basic Power Automate workflows or SharePoint document management is a plus.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About SMARD Art**  
SMARD Art is a Black-owned, global company and the world’s leading retailer of Black art. Our work is available at T.J. Maxx, HomeGoods, and Marshalls. Our mission is to make Black art mainstream and help it find a place in every home.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Social Media Manager who is a creative in their own right. You can take a vision and make it real, and you'll bring ideas we wouldn’t have without you. You trust your eye, can explain why a creative choice works, and can take an idea from a conversation to something people want to watch and share.

You will own SMARD Art’s social channels, personally create original content, and manage our Social Media Coordinator. You’ll work with a team of creatives to bring campaigns to life and pitch ideas of your own. You’ll also help shape how the brand sounds in conversation with our community and appear on camera when the content calls for it.

This is a demanding, fast-paced startup role. You’ll be balancing channels, campaigns, and deadlines while building the systems that help the team grow. We’re looking for someone driven by the mission and excited to show the world what we’re building.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own social strategy and execution. Set the direction for Instagram and TikTok, build the content calendar, and manage publishing across campaigns, product launches, and events.
* Bring creative ideas to life. Collaborate with the creative team to translate campaign concepts into social content. Pitch original ideas and personally script, shoot, and edit short-form videos, from product and lifestyle storytelling to behind-the-scenes moments. Create graphics and templates in Canva as needed.
* Represent SMARD Art on camera. Capture lifestyle content in the moment, speak naturally on camera, and appear in content on behalf of the brand when the story calls for it.
* Build and engage our community. Carry a conversational brand voice across posts, comments, and DMs. Build relationships with followers, artists, creators, and brand advocates. Create opportunities for people to participate and share their own content, and handle sensitive conversations with sound judgment.
* Manage the Social Media Coordinator. Set priorities, delegate clearly, and give constructive feedback that helps them grow and keeps the work moving.
* Build systems that can scale. Set up practical workflows for planning, production, approvals, publishing, and reporting so multiple campaigns and channels can move at once.  
  Use insights to improve the work. Follow audience behavior, platform trends, and relevant cultural conversations. Track performance, report what you’re learning, and use it to decide what to make, test, or develop further.

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* A demonstrated commitment to celebrating Black culture through creativity. This is essential. Your work should show a distinct perspective and a pulse on the artists, ideas, and cultural moments shaping Black communities in the U.S. and across the diaspora. You know what will resonate with our community and when SMARD Art has something meaningful to add.
* Experience owning social accounts for a brand or public-facing individual. You’ve been directly responsible for publishing, community engagement, and performance, and you can speak to results you helped drive.
* Hands-on short-form production skills. You can take an idea from concept to a publish-ready video. You have a strong eye for visuals, sound, and pacing, and you’re comfortable editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or a comparable tool and creating assets in Canva.
* Community-building experience and a natural voice. You know how to turn audience interaction into relationships, and you bring personality and judgment to how you write, speak, and represent a brand.
* Exceptional organization and strong people skills. You can juggle multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and build your own systems to keep projects moving. You’re comfortable giving feedback and taking initiative when priorities shift.

  

**Nice To Have**

* A creative practice or original work you make independently.
* A global perspective shaped by travel, lived experience, or creative work across communities.
* Experience managing or mentoring someone.
* Experience building workflows at a startup or on a small team.

  

**How To Apply**

Please share:

* Examples of social accounts you’ve managed, what you owned, and one result you helped drive.
* Two or three short-form videos you personally created, with a quick note on what you handled for each.
* A few sentences on the creative perspective you’d bring to SMARD Art and where we can see it in your work.

**About Indo-American Center:** The Indo-American Center (IAC) was established as a community based, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization in 1990 by a group of Indian immigrants seeking to respond to the needs of their fellow growing South Asian immigrant population. Located near Devon Ave, at the heart of “Little India” in the West Ridge neighborhood of Chicago, IAC is deeply rooted in the community it serves. IAC connects clients to resources and opportunities that improve their individual community and quality of life through direct service, outreach, education, access, and advocacy. IAC operates six core programs: immigration legal services, citizenship, community engagement and organizing, adult education, health education and screenings, and a seniors’ program.

**Location:** Chicago, IL, Des Plaines, IL (Hybrid/On-site, three (3) days per week in-office or at designated work locations; two (2) days remote.

**Partnership & Outreach Coordination – 25%**

* Support the coordination of events and service delivery in collaboration with community partners and stakeholders.

* Track and document services delivered, clients served, and outreach activities completed

* Two to three years of experience in direct services, case management, or community liaison work.
* Knowledge of immigration processes and immigrant rights.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi and/or Urdu required.
* Experience working with under-resourced communities, including immigrant and refugee populations.
* Familiarity with Chicago-area and Chicagoland service providers, referral networks, and community resources.

* Comfortable facilitating presentations, Know Your Rights sessions, or workshops for community members, partners, and stakeholders.

* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends to meet community needs and support outreach activities.

Agency EA, a part of EA Collective, is a 100% employee-owned, award-winning experiential marketing agency specializing in live, virtual, and hybrid experiences for global brands. Known for its ability to blend strategy, creativity, and flawless execution, Agency EA partners with clients to bring their brands to life through impactful events, immersive environments, and engaging digital activations. As the flagship agency of EA Collective, Agency EA benefits from the broader collective’s creative resources and industry-leading expertise to innovate and deliver unforgettable experiences that resonate with audiences and achieve business objectives.  
  
We are looking for dreamers and doers who have the passion to champion big ideas and the talent to bring them to life. A place of acceptance and open dialogue, we strive to foster a culture where differences are not just valued, but celebrated. Come do your best and be your best in a casual yet vibrant workplace where we prioritize professional and personal growth, commit to causes we believe in, and ensure a diverse and inclusive community.  
  
This position is based in Chicago and will involve a combination of remote and in-office work. This role also requires travel to multiple markets to support client activations.  
  
**Summary**  
An Account Manager manages a variety of client accounts and delivers an exceptional client experience by having a natural attention to detail and the ability to anticipate and interpret client needs. Account Managers lead project teams to deliver creative and flawless events and experiential marketing programs that are on strategy, in budget, and executed on time. Account Managers at Agency EA are master communicators and the primary contact between project team members and clients. An Account Manager nurtures and builds relationships with multi-level client contacts to identify and develop strategic business building opportunities for clients and the agency, and is responsible for developing the agency’s future talent by training and coaching Account Coordinators and Account Executives to ensure performance and execution excellence.  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Maintain and build relationships with clients including strategy development, project management, and overall communication.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ culture, processes, business, and structure to service them effectively. Share learnings and insights with agency team members to ensure consistency of service.
* Meet with and liaise with clients to identify and discuss their audience engagement/experiential marketing program requirements.
* Recommend new and innovative approaches and directions to accomplish the marketing and engagement objectives of clients.
* Ensure that key written communications are strategic, meet the agency’s standard of excellence and are provided in a timely manner.
* Lead project teams to deliver successful, results-driven programs.
* Evaluate the strategic development of the creative product and ensure that the work meets client objectives, brand positioning and guidelines.
* Present or support the presentation of creative work to clients.
* Respond to changes in direction and other client dynamics with flexibility, resourcefulness and a problem-solving mindset.
* Lead weekly status meetings with project team members. Discuss key components of the project, provide guidance, and outline next steps.
* Review and collaborate on all production related deliverables including but not limited to production schedules, run of show documents, and logistics plans; work with Production lead to determine the best way to communicate deliverables to clients.
* Conduct actualization process with Production lead; once all information is organized, finalize actualization process with Controller.
* Foster exceptional performance among agency team members.
* Manage project team members to maximize efficiencies and minimize redundancies; identify inefficiencies in project workflow and implement plans to address them.
* Provide on-site/at event client management. Communicate with clients frequently and ensure that all needs are met.
* Share best practices and program learnings with project team members. Recommend solutions and process modifications for continuous improvement.
* Partner with Client Services leadership to develop proposals that address the objectives and assignment as outlined by clients; proposals to include creative concepts and/or initial budgets.
* Develop a Project Brief
* Outline strategy(s) to achieve stated objectives.
* Review target audience research; identify insights.
* Write and/or enhance creative concepts.
* Outline initial budget estimate; ensure that budgets achieve revenue targets.
* Train and mentor Account Coordinators and Account Executives on an on-going basis to ensure growth and performance excellence. Provide constructive feedback informally as well as for performance evaluations.
* Preserve and foster EA’s culture and maintain a positive and forward-thinking attitude.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Bachelors degree or higher; Marketing, Communications, Business or another related field a plus.
* Agency experience is a must.
* Event and/or experiential marketing experience is a must.
* Strong written, oral and interpersonal communication skills.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Strategic thinker, able to help guide ideas to align with clients’ strategy.
* Excellent organizational and team management skills.
* Must enjoy working and collaborating with teams.
* Must be proficient in Google Workspace/Suite or Excel, PowerPoint and Keynote.
* Must be willing to travel as needed.

Salary depends on experience and ranges from $75,000 to $85,000.

Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City (Primary), Denver, Chicago, Singapore (APAC), London, San Francisco, Austin, Los Angeles  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who makes customers successful, not just satisfied. Our customers run agents on real work, where the output has to be right the first time.

As a Customer Success Manager at Endex, you'll own deployment, onboarding, adoption and renewal across our accounts. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape how customers succeed and what we build next.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts from signature through renewal. Know their goals, their teams and exactly where Endex fits in their work.
* **Lead Deployments:** Get new customers live fast. Run kickoffs, configure integrations and partner with IT and InfoSec to clear the path to production.
* **Train and Enable Users:** Run onboarding sessions and workshops that show teams what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make every user productive in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Monitor usage, find the teams getting the most value and replicate it across the firm. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide deployment.
* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Spot risk early and fix it before it becomes churn. Surface expansion opportunities and partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** You'll hear every request, edge case and frustration first. Translate that into product feedback, bug reports and roadmap input that keeps us ahead.
* **Build the Function:** Create the onboarding playbooks, health metrics and support processes we'll scale on. You're not just running customer success. You're helping define it.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven customer leader:** 2+ years in customer success, account management, implementation or consulting. You've owned enterprise accounts and grown them.
* **Customer-obsessed:** You care whether the people you work with actually succeed. You follow up, follow through and make yourself the person customers call first.
* **Technically fluent:** You learn new software quickly and can explain it to anyone. You're comfortable working through integrations, security questions and edge cases with engineers.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.

### **Who we are**

Here at Waitwhile we’re on a mission to eliminate the 1 trillion hours people spend waiting in lines every year. Our platform combines virtual waitlists, scheduling, real-time updates, messaging, and analytics to make access to places, services, and events seamless, online or in person. Trusted by 10,000+ companies, Waitwhile has already helped more than 250 million people enjoy a radically better waiting experience. Our clients include IKEA, Louis Vuitton, Costco, Delta Airlines and many more. We’re just getting started, and we need your help.

### **The role**

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative to join our sales team, based in Chicago.

You’ll drive outbound prospecting to engage decision-makers, book qualified meetings, and build pipeline for our Account Executives. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to improve targeting, messaging, and handoffs.

Our outbound motion is still taking shape, so this is not a role where you step into a finished machine. You’ll help shape how we prospect, test what works, and bring ideas that are heard and acted on.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build, loves the energy of outbound sales, and is aiming for a career in closing deals.

### **What you’ll do**

**Drive outbound prospecting:** Reach decision-makers in target accounts through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other channels, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

**Research and personalize:** Identify the right people within target accounts and tailor your outreach where it matters, while keeping strong activity levels.

**Help build the outbound motion:** Partner with sales leadership to refine targeting, messaging, and outreach strategy, and help set early best practices for outbound at Waitwhile.

**Manage tools and workflow:** Use Amplemarket, Trellus, ZoomInfo, and HubSpot to prospect, prioritize accounts, and execute outreach, and keep pipeline data clean and accurate.

**Ensure great handoffs:** Partner with our Account Executives to make sure every opportunity is aligned and every meeting starts on the right foot.

**Collaborate cross-functionally:** Share prospect feedback, market insights, and objections from your conversations with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps.

### **What skills you need**

* 1–2+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or outbound prospecting, for example as a BDR or SDR.
* Strong self-starter mentality with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Comfortable operating in an environment where not everything is fully built yet.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and confidence on the phone.
* Resilience, curiosity, and a willingness to test, learn, and improve quickly.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with solid follow-through.
* A high school diploma (a bachelor’s degree is a plus).
* Legal authorization to work in the United States. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN) for this position.  
    
  **Bonus Skills & Attributes:**
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Amplemarket, Trellus, or similar prospecting tools.
* Founding, early-stage, or startup experience.
* Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
* Experience selling to operations, CX, retail, healthcare, travel, or other service-heavy industries.
* Experience helping shape messaging, cadences, or outbound processes in a prior role.

### **A great place to work ️**

We want Waitwhile to be an incredible place to work. We offer great benefits and perks, flexible working hours and lots of interesting challenges. We believe in making work rewarding, care about your development, and are committed to your success. For high performers, there is a clear path to an Account Executive role. The Hulu and ABC Publicity team is seeking a Coordinator, Publicity to provide high-quality administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity while developing hands-on experience across the day-to-day work of the publicity function. This role is designed for someone who has a genuine interest in pursuing a career in entertainment publicity and is eager to build a strong foundation in both executive support and publicity coordination.

The Coordinator will focus on becoming highly proficient in core desk responsibilities, including calendar management, expenses, meetings, and team administration. As the individual demonstrates proficiency, they will have opportunities to take on broader publicity assignments, including media monitoring, press materials, campaign logistics, events, and special projects. Administrative support will remain an important and ongoing part of the position.

This is a developmental role intended to integrate the Coordinator into the daily needs of the business, strengthen their publicity skills, and prepare them for continued growth within the function.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to two Vice Presidents across Hulu and ABC Publicity, including managing two complex calendars, coordinating meetings and conference calls, and navigating schedule changes.
* Prepare and submit expense reports; support invoices, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and other departmental administrative processes.
* Maintain team contact lists, departmental documents, status reports, and shared resources.
* Coordinate staff meetings and other group meetings; take notes, track action items, and distribute relevant information to the team.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Build strong working relationships across the Hulu and ABC Publicity teams and with internal and external partners.
* Balance the priorities of two Vice Presidents and two publicity teams, communicating proactively when needs or deadlines compete.

**As the Role Progresses, You Will Have Opportunities To:**

* Support publicity coordination activities such as media monitoring, compiling and distributing press coverage, maintaining press lists and media-site materials, and researching industry trends and media opportunities.
* Assist with drafting and proofreading publicity materials, including episodic loglines, biographies, press releases, announcements, and other campaign documents.
* Help coordinate talent and campaign logistics, including travel, schedules, glam, screenings, press junkets, panels, premieres, awards events, and other publicity activities.
* Participate in team brainstorms and contribute to campaign, event, and special-project execution.
* Support publicity events as needed, including occasional evenings and weekends.
* Take on additional publicity responsibilities based on demonstrated proficiency, capacity, business needs, and readiness, while continuing to provide essential administrative support.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated interest in building a career in entertainment publicity; candidates seeking a role focused solely on executive administration may not be the best fit.
* Prior administrative, communications, publicity, marketing, agency, studio, network, platform, or related experience.
* Ability to learn and become proficient in executive desk responsibilities while showing initiative and curiosity about the broader publicity function.

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager - West
new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Key Account Manager (KAM) - West

**Region:** US West (CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, WY, NV, UT, AZ) & Asia Pacific (APAC)

**Location:** Must live in US, in region

**Department:** Business Development

**Effective Date:** January 1, 2027

  

**Genea Overview:**

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits including 401k matching; PTO; 100% paid parental leave; 100% paid employee health, dental and vision benefits; remote work options; and an award-winning workplace culture.

  

**Job Overview:**

Genea is in an exciting phase of growth, and there’s never been a better time to join the team! We’re scaling rapidly, expanding our team, and creating brand-new roles—like this one—to help us innovate faster, serve our customers better, and take our success to the next level.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for engaging directly with large enterprise end users selling Genea Access Control solutions. This role is responsible for developing, expanding and maintaining ecosystem and integrator partner relationship, and will work directly with their respective global accounts teams. This individual is an experienced solutions salesperson who can think wholistically about modern SaaS applications, end customer’s adoption of cloud technologies, and various go to market strategies. The Genea KAM position requires travel and a strong aptitude for account management, technical sales, and working across a wide variety of enterprise sales environments. The Key Account Manager position reports directly to the Head of Sales.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage strategic channel partner relationships.
* Drive revenue through new customer acquisition.
* Target large, distributed, and often global end customers.
* Manage accounts through a complex buying process.
* Deliver expert quality sales presentations, end user demos of Genea access control, and visitor management solutions.
* Create strategic account plans that outline goals, strategies, and action steps to ensure alignment between the partner's objectives and the Genea organization.
* Conduct regular QBRs with accounts to discuss progress, outcomes, and any adjustments needed to the account plan.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, gather feedback, and share results to continuously improve the account experience and ensure future success.
* Use data and analytics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.
* Utilize and leverage data to construct, forecast, and manage sales activities to meet revenue targets and company goals.
* Manage a travel schedule comprised of weekly/monthly trips – meeting customers, prospects, and technology partners. Expected travel is 40%.
* Work within a team to develop sale proposals, quotations, and pricing strategies to win business.
* Stay current with the latest developments in the marketplace and competitor activities.
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute in-market customer events.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 5-7 years of sales experience with a B2B SaaS company managing Key Accounts in Physical Security or related product types, in a channel environment
* Must reside in the US within the territory (CA, OR, WA, ID, MT, WY, NV, UT, or AZ).
* Bachelor's Degree with a concentration in Business, Communications, or related focus area is preferred.
* Proven track record in technical sales and key account management.
* Demonstrated ability to consistently generate revenue and exceed sales goals by managing processes for identifying, qualifying, and closing new business.
* Experience utilizing complex sales techniques within the enterprise sales process.
* Proven track record of revenue growth in a technology centric organization.
* Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
* Aptitude for presentation writing and delivery.
* Ability to travel as needed within region (approximately 25-30% travel).

  

**Estimated Salary Range:** $150K base salary, up to $240K total compensation including sales commission and bonuses

The salary range listed is our best estimate based on the role's requirements and market conditions, but the final offer may be higher or lower depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

  

Genea participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit the E-Verify website.
