new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D) is seeking a** **Project Coordinator** **—an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive professional who enjoys keeping complex project work moving, managing details, and serving as a trusted resource to project teams and clients. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who communicates clearly, balances multiple priorities with confidence, and brings strong financial and project coordination capabilities to a fast-paced environment.**


This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

**The Opportunity**

At B&D, we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and play. B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services and expanding our capabilities across the full project lifecycle.

As a Project Coordinator, you will provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support. You will work closely with project managers, clients, consultants, contractors, and administrative staff to keep project information, financial tracking, documentation, meetings, and key deliverables organized and moving forward.

**How You’ll Contribute**

* Coordinate project schedules, deliverables, documentation, correspondence, and follow-up activities across project teams.
* Create and maintain organized electronic project files and project documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Support project financial management by assisting with budgets, cash-flow estimates, commitment schedules, monthly draw packages, payables, and financial reporting.
* Gather and review information from project stakeholders to support accurate reporting and timely processing of key deliverables.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, appointments, and site visits; prepare agendas, presentation materials, and supporting documents.
* Attend project meetings, prepare and distribute meeting minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Support coordination among clients, designers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal project team members.
* Assist with consultant, contractor, and vendor solicitation, procurement, contract administration, and approval tracking.
* Monitor project details, scope changes, requests for information, submittals, and other information flows to help keep work on schedule.
* Support project controls and reporting related to status, cost, schedule, and open items.
* Assist with proposals, contracts, and project closeout activities as needed.
* Build responsive, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders while handling confidential information with discretion.

What we are looking for:

* 4+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally within construction, owner’s representation, program management, architecture/engineering, real estate development, or a related professional services environment.
* 2+ years of financial experience, including budget tracking, project financial analysis, reporting, invoicing, draw preparation, or similar responsibilities.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required; coursework or a degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, architecture, construction, or a related field is beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* General understanding of project management processes, project controls, construction documentation, and sequencing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and produce high-quality work in a fast-paced project environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a broader project team.
* Sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Client-service mindset and ability to build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What Sets You Apart**

You anticipate what the team needs before being asked and reliably follow work through to completion. You are comfortable working with financial and project information, enjoy bringing order to complex moving parts, and communicate confidently with clients and project partners. You stay composed when priorities shift, take ownership of details, and are motivated by becoming a trusted resource for the people you support.

Within your first six to twelve months, success will mean independently managing key administrative and coordination functions, supporting project financial tracking and reporting, and serving as a dependable resource for both clients and internal project teams.

**Why People Choose B&D**

**Impactful Mission-** Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, work, and connect.

**Learning & Growth-** We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

**Strong Culture-** Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drives how we work together.

**Robust Benefits-** Comprehensive benefits include 100% company-paid medical, dental, and prescription coverage, a targeted 7% employer-contribution 401(k), generous PTO, cell phone reimbursement and more.

**Apply Today!**

new_jobs.description:
The Communications Coordinator position is directly responsible for promoting FAMSF to local, national and international audiences. This position works effectively and collegially with a broad range of staff members and has direct interaction with members of the media and demands responsibility, initiative, accuracy, diplomacy, and tact. Additionally, the Communications Coordinator will provide direct support and assistance to the Communications team, taking guidance from the Communications Manager.

The application deadline is Sunday, November 22, 2026, 9 PM PST.

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Responsible for fulfillment and tracking of daily media requests including: retrieving incoming calls and emails, monitoring press inbox, sending information and images, responding to basic questions, and directing requests to appropriate supervisors, spokesperson(s), and/or departments as necessary.

* With guidance from the Communications Manager, responsible for maintaining accuracy of media database, updating reporter contact information, beats, and all other relevant information. Adds contacts as directed and recommends additions.

* Crafts compelling and unique pitches that result in positive coverage for designated exhibitions, public programs and educational offerings.

* Composes press materials for upcoming initiatives including: researching, writing, and circulating compelling press releases, concise media alerts, supplemental materials, and preparing electronic press kits including press images.

* Assist in tracking coverage, pulling reports, summaries and analytics for regular reporting.
* Supports media visits, photography, videography, podcasts, content creators, and television shoots as needed.

* Liaises with the Marketing and Web and Digital teams to appropriately schedule PR distributions, to align email sends and online press releases. Works collaboratively with the Communications team to pull strategic distribution lists.
* Supports in planning press previews, working with internal museum stakeholders on event logistics. Handles tracking of RSVP lists and follow ups for press lists at all institutional events.

* Works with Marketing team to coordinate installation photoshoots, including handling internal logistics and scheduling with photographer.
* Actively participates in brainstorms and media strategy meetings with the rest of the Communications team, and with Division. Contributes to Division wide meetings and monitors team’s projects in Asana.

* Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, or other related field from an accredited college or university.
* Work Experience: Minimum of two years of experience in communications, public relations, and/or administrative assistance.

Professional Skills and Abilities:

* Some familiarity with local media landscape and Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco audiences.
* Knowledge of procedures used in preparing and distributing publicity and public information materials.
* Excellent organizational, writing, and communication skills.
* Requires computer proficiency, Google suite and database management.
* Ability to take direction, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take initiative.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy.
* Flexibility in meeting shifting demands and priorities.
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects in a complex, highly demanding, and fast paced work environment.
* Discretion to handle confidential information.
* Absolute attention to detail.

Additional:

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Hybrid schedules are a minimum of 4 days a week onsite, with the understanding that schedules may change based on operational needs. The workweek is Monday - Friday, 8 hours a day, 40 hours per week.

Compensation: This is a union position eligible for the Museums' benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance and a generous time off package. There is a 7-step union pay scale for this position: Step 1 (starting rate) is $30.05 per hour, Step 7 (max rate) is $40.27. Generally, new employees start at the beginning of the pay scale.

Application Deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026, 9 PM PST. We plan to launch the interview process in December.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources @ famsf.org.

\_\_\_

COFAM is the Corporation of Fine Arts Museums and is the privately funded non-profit corporation which supports the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco, a department of the City and County of San Francisco.

COFAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all phases of employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Comprising the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park, we are the largest public arts institution in the City of San Francisco and one of the largest art museums in the United States. The de Young, designed by Herzog & de Meuron and located in Golden Gate Park, showcases American art from the 17th through the 21st centuries, international contemporary art, textiles and costumes, and art from the Americas, the Pacific, and Africa. The Legion of Honor displays a collection of over 4,000 years of ancient and European art including Auguste Rodin's The Thinker and houses the Achenbach Foundation for Graphic Arts in a Beaux-Arts style building overlooking Lincoln Park and the Golden Gate Bridge.

new_jobs.description:
**About Securitas USA**  
Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is the global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across a wide range of industries. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help make your world a safer place. With a proud legacy of 90 years, built on trust, innovation, and international expertise, we take pride in offering security solutions that are tailored to each client’s unique needs. By combining cutting-edge technology with exceptional service, we continue to redefine what safety and security mean in today's world.

Menlo Park, CA

As a Regional Account Manager, you will be responsible for leading in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your decisions directly influence outcomes. **Required Education & Experience**

**Why you would want to join the team**

Tatcha is a skincare brand rooted in timeless Japanese wisdom, offering transformative yet kind-to-skin formulas that marry Japanese botanicals with clinical ingredients. Our formulation philosophy is informed by the Japanese concept hinou dokon, which means "skin-mind same root"—an acknowledgement of the powerful connection between the skin and the brain. Guided by the mission to care for people through their skin, Tatcha takes a holistic approach to skincare from concept to formulation to clinical evaluation, offering skincare rituals that benefit both skin and mind, while emphasizing the importance of mindfulness to skin health.

* Support the planning and implementation of promotional programs, product launches, and retail activations instore & online, including sku setup process.

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by **LOIS**, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

**Role Summary:**
-----------------

Here's the honest pitch: field sales is a brand-new motion at Filevine, and we're looking for the person who builds it. Not runs a proven playbook — writes it. You'll be the first Filevine salesperson to plant a flag in your territory, and everything you learn on the ground becomes the blueprint for the reps who come after you. If "figure it out and build it from scratch" makes you lean in rather than flinch, keep reading.  
  
This is a true outside sales role. You'll be in the field at least four days a week — walking into law firms, meeting paralegals and attorneys face-to-face, working bar association events, and becoming the most familiar name in your territory for deposition services.  
  
This isn't an email job. It's not a Zoom job. You win by showing up — consistently, professionally, and with something useful to say every time. You'll also need range: the ability to build rapport in the reception area and get your foot in the door with a paralegal, and the sophistication to sit across from a managing partner and hold your own on price, value, and strategy. This is a premium-priced product in a market full of commodity providers — so you have to be able to sell the difference, not just the service. If you love the rhythm of door-to-door selling, can navigate a downtown legal corridor, and have the discipline to run a territory like your own small business, you'll thrive here. There is no ceiling on your earnings

### **What You'll Do**

* Build the playbook. As the first rep in your territory, you'll test what works, document it, and help shape the model Filevine scales from. Your wins and your lessons both matter.
* Own a defined geographic territory and build a daily route plan that maximizes face-to-face time with litigation attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants, and firm administrators.
* Spend at least four days per week in the field — walking into firms, dropping by reception, scheduling lunches, and turning every visit into a relationship.
* Get your foot in the door at every level: earn trust with paralegals and legal staff, then work your way up to the conversations with managing partners and firm administrators who sign off on the deal.
* Sell Filevine's full deposition stack — court reporting, remote depositions, and AI-powered products including Depo CoPilot — as a premium offering in a commodity market. You'll own the "why we're worth it" story.
* Drive initial customer enablement, training, and product adoption — get new firms up and running, walk them through their first depositions, and make sure they're confident with the product. (A dedicated in-house team handles full, ongoing trainings; your job is to spark and seed adoption.)
* Attend local and regional industry events: bar association meetings, CLEs, paralegal association mixers, and trial lawyer chapters. Be the visible Filevine presence in your market.
* Run disciplined prospecting: outbound calls, drop-bys, follow-ups, and a tight cadence on every account.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every visit, conversation, and opportunity in CRM (Salesforce). Forecast projected targets and deals.
* Partner closely with Operations, Scheduling, and Client Success to deliver a seamless deposition experience.

### **You'll Crush This Role If You Have**

* 3–5+ years of outside sales experience, ideally selling into law firms or to attorneys — court reporting, legal videography, e-discovery, medical records retrieval, or legal tech.
* An existing network in the local legal community.
* A builder's mindset — you're energized by white space, ambiguity, and being the one who figures out what works before there's a manual for it.
* A proven track record of building a book of business from in-person relationships — not inbound leads.
* The range to connect with anyone in the building: warm and credible with a paralegal, sharp and strategic with a managing partner.
* Demonstrated ability to learn a new industry quickly and translate insights to subject-matter experts (in this case, litigators).
* Comfort selling a premium product against cheaper alternatives — you know how to make value the conversation instead of price.
* High activity, high agency: you build your own pipeline, run your own day, and don't wait for marketing to hand you names.
* Comfort walking into a law firm cold, navigating gatekeepers, and earning a first conversation.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation; you live in or near your assigned territory.

### **Nice to Have**

* A referral network of attorneys, court reporters, videographers, and adjacent service providers.
* Familiarity with deposition workflows, litigation timelines, and how legal services are purchased.

Compensation Information: $110,000 - $140,000 + commission

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity -

35

We're seeking a Business Operations Associate to play a critical role in driving growth, operational excellence, and customer success. new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Systems Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Revenue Systems Manager at Ardoq**
====================================

**Keep our GTM systems running smoothly, so the people closest to our customers can always rely on the tools.**

**The Ardoq Story**
-------------------

Ardoq is one of Norway's most exciting scale-ups, a truly global company built out of Oslo. We are a SaaS platform that helps organizations understand, manage, and evolve their complex digital landscape. By providing a dynamic, collaborative "digital twin" of their business, we connect systems, people, and processes to drive better decision-making and accelerate digital transformation.

Today, we help some of the world's most complex organizations, like ExxonMobil and BT, gain clarity in a changing world. We are backed by leading global tech investors, including EQT and One Peak, giving us the stability of a mature company with the speed and soul of a startup.

**About the Role**
------------------

Every GTM team at Ardoq depends on Salesforce and its integrated applications working the way they should: a lead reaching the right rep in seconds, a quote going out the door in minutes. As our Revenue Systems Manager, you'll be responsible for the health of Salesforce and its integrations, moving seamlessly between quick tickets and carefully scoped system improvements.

In this role, you’ll be working closely with our Customer leadership to support our processes and insights that drive renewals, expansion and retention.

At Ardoq, we value autonomy and psychological safety. In this role, you won't just follow a script; you will have the influence to shape your domain and the ownership to see your ideas through to execution.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own Salesforce, end to end: You'll be one of two dedicated Salesforce admins owning user set-up and permissions, as well as the configuration and ongoing optimization of Salesforce as part of our wider tech ecosystem.
* Partner across GTM: work closely with Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services and Sales to turn real business problems into system solutions people actually trust and use.
* Lead system projects: you’ll drive system projects that might range from deploying a CPQ tool to establishing a robust Customer SQL framework.
* Cultural contribution: help shape the habits of a small, high-trust team where picking up a ticket and shipping a project matter equally.

**On a typical day, you will**
------------------------------

Start by clearing a handful of tickets, the small stuff that keeps Sales and CS moving. Then shift into project mode: reviewing a Flow that's throwing errors, scoping the next phase of an important integration, or sitting down with our VP of Customer Success or Professional Services to optimize a post-sales process. You'll lean on AI tools daily, to check a formula, sanity-check an automation, or move faster through a repetitive task, because that's simply how good admin work gets done now. Some days are almost entirely tickets. Some are almost entirely project work. Most days are a mix of both.

**Who you are**
---------------

The Experience: you hold a current Salesforce Administrator certification and have supported Salesforce inside a high-growth tech company. You’ve had roles with a dedicated focus on customer operations and understand how to support a Customer team and their focus on renewals and retention.

The Mindset: you're happy being one of a small team, not one of many. You move comfortably between answering a ticket and running a project, often on the same day, and the unglamorous work isn't beneath you.

The Tools: You're a certified Salesforce Admin. You use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow, not as an occasional experiment, to move faster and catch things you'd otherwise miss.

The Communicator: you can explain a system change to a non-technical stakeholder in terms of what it means for their day, not just what changed under the hood.

**The "Ardoq Way"**
-------------------

We live by three values, Bold, Caring, and Driven, that define how we work, how we treat each other, and how we win.

* BOLD: you continuously raise the bar for yourself and others, starting from a place of "what if I could?" You act decisively, even when the information isn't complete, choosing forward motion and learning over waiting for the perfect answer.
* CARING: you care enough to be candid, delivering direct, kind, and timely feedback that helps your teammates grow. You operate as one team, sharing knowledge openly, celebrating others' wins, and putting collective success ahead of your own.
* DRIVEN: at Ardoq, everyone has a stake in the outcome, including stock options. You act like an owner: measuring success by impact rather than effort, saying "no" to distractions, and staying focused on the highest-value work at pace.

**Why Ardoq?**
--------------

We believe that high performance is powered by wellbeing. You'll have access to a competitive package that supports performance, wellbeing, and long-term success.

* Employee Stock Options, share in Ardoq's success as we grow together
* 25 days annual leave, offered globally
* Enhanced parental leave, available globally, to support you and your family
* 401(k) retirement plan, and health, disability, and life insurance
* Annual learning budget to support your growth and development
* New York-based team members should be excited to be in the office once or twice a week.

Compensation: $120,000 - $140,000

**How to Apply**
----------------

Send us your resume, we'd love to hear from you. Our hiring process typically includes: TA screen hiring manager interview case interview values interview. We provide thoughtful feedback at every step.

**Final Note**
--------------

At Ardoq, every teammate has a voice. Whether you love tackling enterprise-scale challenges or improving how companies run, you'll not only belong, you'll impact, grow, and make work meaningful.

#LI-Remote

Conduit Health is transforming one of the most outdated corners of post-acute care—getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients' homes. We're the first vertically integrated, AI-powered platform to unite ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. In seconds, case managers and providers can say "yes" to patients who would otherwise wait weeks — while we handle every step behind the scenes.  
  
**The Role**

We are looking for a Content & Social Media Manager to own our social media channels and build the content engine that will help propel Conduit into the next stage of growth.

The best fit for this role is someone who is hungry to be a true operator and build a function from the ground up. You'll work directly with senior leadership to help craft the Conduit story and be hands on keyboard executing on that vision. You're comfortable operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with shifting priorities.

This role reports to the Head of Marketing. It's a hands-on individual contributor role today, with the resources you need to move fast – and a clear path to growing a team around you.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Organic channel ownership:** Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit & more. You'll build the roadmap, expand our presence, own the calendar, write the copy, and post the content.
* **Build the content engine:** Blog posts, newsletters, case studies, social posts (video, static & written), Influencer content, white papers, patient stories & more. You'll manage how to produce content that is SEO-minded & valuable to patients at scale, and decide what’s built in-house or resourced.

* **Measure and adjust:** You’ll define what success looks like, and use data to measure it.

### **Who You Are**

* **Builder:** You want to create a function and make decisions that matter. The blank page excites you.
* **Native to the feed:** You understand how these platforms actually work, and know how to leverage all the tools available to earn the right engagement.
* **Clear & efficient writer:** You’re a strong writer across a number of mediums, and you’re comfortable with fast turnarounds.

**In your first 90 days you’ll:**

* Launch a consistent presence on LinkedIn and Meta.
* Build the content playbook: calendar, voice guidelines, templates, review process.
* Publish our first SEO-driven guides and case studies.
* Show early movement against baseline in SEO, engagement, and audience growth.

### **Our Values**

* **Excellence, Not Perfection:** We set a high bar for our work and impact, but we don't get lost in endless polish for polish's sake. We focus on results that matter.
* **Urgency, Not Chaos:** We move fast because speed drives our advantage. We pair urgency with clarity to avoid noise and burnout.
* **Systems, Not One-Offs:** Every solution should eliminate the root cause so the problem never returns. Wins are good; scalable systems are better.
* **Committed, Not Just Here:** We show up engaged, proactive, and ready to go above and beyond. The outcomes you drive are what matter most.
* **Crush Goals, Not Souls:** We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Be yourself, bring positivity, have fun, and laugh often.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* Flexible hybrid work environment
* Unlimited PTO + company holidays
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Direct mentorship and growth opportunities
* Opportunity to help shape and scale operations at a fast-growing healthcare startup

### **Equal Opportunity**

Conduit Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**

Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network focused on late-phase, industry-sponsored trials for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator I at our clinical research site located in the Bronx. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience. Experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

  

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

new_jobs.description:
### **About Throne**

Throne is a fast growing Series C startup transforming local communities by delivering clean, safe, accessible restrooms to cities, transit agencies, and public spaces. With flagship customers in Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Ann Arbor, and Washington DC, and recent launches in New York City, Atlanta, and Seattle, we're rapidly scaling into new markets in 2027 and beyond.

We recognize an unspoken problem: that better bathroom accommodations are sorely needed in most cities. Public and retail bathrooms are neither positioned to meet demand, nor incentivized to provide the quality experience people deserve.

Our mission is to provide peace of mind to the millions of people who set out on an adventure on any given day. That adventure may be big or small. It may involve taking your toddler to the park, driving a stranger to the airport, running a half marathon, or exploring a new city for the first time.

**About the Job**

Throne is looking for Operations Specialists (Cleaners) to join our team, reporting to the Atlanta Operations Manager. * Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and prioritize tasks efficiently
* Physical ability to perform manual labor, including lifting
* Comfortable working in outdoor/public environments and interacting positively with users
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record
* Reliable method of transportation, ideally your own vehicle, eligible for mileage reimbursement
* Must be 23 years or older with at least two years of driving experience

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior cleaning experience, or prior experience in the portable sanitation industry

### **Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with medical options that are 100% employer-paid

new_jobs.title: Event Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Agency Overview**  
Agency EA, a part of EA Collective, is a 100% employee-owned, award-winning experiential marketing agency specializing in live, virtual, and hybrid experiences for global brands. Known for its ability to blend strategy, creativity, and flawless execution, Agency EA partners with clients to bring their brands to life through impactful events, immersive environments, and engaging digital activations. As the flagship agency of EA Collective, Agency EA benefits from the broader collective’s creative resources and industry-leading expertise to innovate and deliver unforgettable experiences that resonate with audiences and achieve business objectives.  
  
We are looking for dreamers and doers who have the passion to champion big ideas and the talent to bring them to life. A place of acceptance and open dialogue, we strive to foster a culture where differences are not just valued, but celebrated. Come do your best and be your best in a casual yet vibrant workplace where we prioritize professional and personal growth, commit to causes we believe in, and ensure a diverse and inclusive community.  
  
This position is based in Chicago and will involve a combination of remote and in-office work. This role also requires travel to multiple markets to support client activations.  
  
**Summary**  
An Account Manager manages a variety of client accounts and delivers an exceptional client experience by having a natural attention to detail and the ability to anticipate and interpret client needs. Account Managers lead project teams to deliver creative and flawless events and experiential marketing programs that are on strategy, in budget, and executed on time. Account Managers at Agency EA are master communicators and the primary contact between project team members and clients. An Account Manager nurtures and builds relationships with multi-level client contacts to identify and develop strategic business building opportunities for clients and the agency, and is responsible for developing the agency’s future talent by training and coaching Account Coordinators and Account Executives to ensure performance and execution excellence.  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Maintain and build relationships with clients including strategy development, project management, and overall communication.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ culture, processes, business, and structure to service them effectively. Share learnings and insights with agency team members to ensure consistency of service.
* Meet with and liaise with clients to identify and discuss their audience engagement/experiential marketing program requirements.
* Recommend new and innovative approaches and directions to accomplish the marketing and engagement objectives of clients.
* Ensure that key written communications are strategic, meet the agency’s standard of excellence and are provided in a timely manner.
* Lead project teams to deliver successful, results-driven programs.
* Evaluate the strategic development of the creative product and ensure that the work meets client objectives, brand positioning and guidelines.
* Present or support the presentation of creative work to clients.
* Respond to changes in direction and other client dynamics with flexibility, resourcefulness and a problem-solving mindset.
* Lead weekly status meetings with project team members. Discuss key components of the project, provide guidance, and outline next steps.
* Review and collaborate on all production related deliverables including but not limited to production schedules, run of show documents, and logistics plans; work with Production lead to determine the best way to communicate deliverables to clients.
* Conduct actualization process with Production lead; once all information is organized, finalize actualization process with Controller.
* Foster exceptional performance among agency team members.
* Manage project team members to maximize efficiencies and minimize redundancies; identify inefficiencies in project workflow and implement plans to address them.
* Provide on-site/at event client management. Communicate with clients frequently and ensure that all needs are met.
* Share best practices and program learnings with project team members. Recommend solutions and process modifications for continuous improvement.
* Partner with Client Services leadership to develop proposals that address the objectives and assignment as outlined by clients; proposals to include creative concepts and/or initial budgets.
* Develop a Project Brief
* Outline strategy(s) to achieve stated objectives.
* Review target audience research; identify insights.
* Write and/or enhance creative concepts.
* Outline initial budget estimate; ensure that budgets achieve revenue targets.
* Train and mentor Account Coordinators and Account Executives on an on-going basis to ensure growth and performance excellence. Provide constructive feedback informally as well as for performance evaluations.
* Preserve and foster EA’s culture and maintain a positive and forward-thinking attitude.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of relevant experience.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City (Primary), Denver, Chicago, Singapore (APAC), London, San Francisco, Austin, Los Angeles  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who makes customers successful, not just satisfied. Our customers run agents on real work, where the output has to be right the first time.

As a Customer Success Manager at Endex, you'll own deployment, onboarding, adoption and renewal across our accounts. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape how customers succeed and what we build next.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts from signature through renewal. Know their goals, their teams and exactly where Endex fits in their work.
* **Lead Deployments:** Get new customers live fast. Run kickoffs, configure integrations and partner with IT and InfoSec to clear the path to production.
* **Train and Enable Users:** Run onboarding sessions and workshops that show teams what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make every user productive in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Monitor usage, find the teams getting the most value and replicate it across the firm. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide deployment.
* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Spot risk early and fix it before it becomes churn. Surface expansion opportunities and partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** You'll hear every request, edge case and frustration first. Translate that into product feedback, bug reports and roadmap input that keeps us ahead.
* **Build the Function:** Create the onboarding playbooks, health metrics and support processes we'll scale on. You're not just running customer success. You're helping define it.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven customer leader:** 2+ years in customer success, account management, implementation or consulting. You've owned enterprise accounts and grown them.
* **Customer-obsessed:** You care whether the people you work with actually succeed. You follow up, follow through and make yourself the person customers call first.
* **Technically fluent:** You learn new software quickly and can explain it to anyone. You're comfortable working through integrations, security questions and edge cases with engineers.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.
* **Commercially minded:** You see renewals and expansion as part of the job. You know how to turn a happy customer into a bigger one.
* **Relentlessly resourceful:** You move fast, leverage your network and figure things out without a playbook.

**Nice to Have**

* Early-stage startup experience
* Experience deploying AI, developer tools or enterprise software

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching
* Competitive Salary + Equity

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**The Role:**

Help prospective clients find the right next step with Morningstar. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll turn interest from marketing campaigns into qualified sales conversations by understanding each prospect’s business needs. You’ll work with marketing and sales colleagues to improve outreach and give account executives the context they need to continue those conversations.

You’ll build your product knowledge and sales skills through prospect research, outreach, and feedback on what works.

This role requires four days a week in our Chicago office.

  

**What you’ll be doing** :

* Follow up on marketing-qualified leads within agreed response times. Research each prospect, use lead scoring to prioritize outreach, and ask questions by phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their needs and readiness to buy.

* Develop early-stage opportunities through follow-up conversations. Arrange meetings and product demonstrations with account executives or sales managers, sharing the prospect’s needs and conversation history.

* Keep prospect records and next steps current in the CRM so sales colleagues can pick up the conversation without losing context.

* Support outbound sales campaigns as needed, adapting your outreach to each prospect’s business challenges.

* Track calls, emails, meetings set, and opportunities generated. Review conversion rates, outreach results, and pipeline growth to identify where the qualification process could improve.

Share feedback with marketing on lead quality and campaign results. Use what you learn about Morningstar’s products, industry trends, and competitor offerings to make your conversations more useful to prospects.  

  

**What we’re looking for:**

* Internship-2 years of experience in customer-facing roles, sales, or business development; experience in business-to-business (B2B) or software-as-a-service (SaaS) settings is preferred.

* A bachelor’s degree is required. Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to listen closely and ask questions that uncover a prospect’s needs.

* The ability to manage several prospect conversations, prioritize follow-ups, and meet agreed response times.

Familiarity with CRM tools, such as Salesforce, and sales engagement platforms, plus the ability to use lead and outreach data to improve your approach.  

  

**The Group:**

Morningstar’s Business Development & Sales group helps financial professionals build their businesses and provide better outcomes for investors.

**Compensation and Benefits**

At Morningstar we believe people are at their best when they are at their healthiest. That’s why we champion your wellness through a wide range of programs that support all stages of your personal and professional life. Here are some examples of the offerings we provide:

* Financial Health

  + 100% 401k match up to 6% of salary
  + Stock Ownership Potential
  + Company provided life insurance - 1x salary + commission
* Physical Health

  + Comprehensive health benefits (medical/dental/vision) including potential premium discounts and company-provided HSA contributions (up to $500-$2,000 annually) for specific plans and coverages
  + Additional medical Wellness Incentives - up to $300-$600 annual
  + Company-provided long- and short-term disability insurance
* Emotional Health

  + Trust-Based Time Off
  + 6-week Paid Sabbatical Program
  + 6-Week Paid Family Caregiving Leave
  + Competitive 8-24 Week Paid Parental Leave
  + Adoption Assistance
  + Leadership Coaching & Formal Mentorship Opportunities
  + Annual Flex Stipend - $1000 annually to cover personal education & well-being expenses
  + Tuition Reimbursement
* Social Health

  + Charitable Matching Gifts program
  + Dollars for Doers volunteer program
  + Paid volunteering days
  + 15+ Employee Resource & Affinity Groups

**Total Cash Compensation Range**

$56,850.00-87,166.66

**Inclusive of annual base salary and target incentive**

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.
